If you have a location signed onto your card, but are on an adventure not being run by the same referee who countersigned the location onto your card, then they are within their rights to disallow that location as a point to which you may 'port to. In case of dispute, the player is assumed to have teleported home. In other ways this glyph functions as per the Elemental Shift spell above. Due to the stresses on the body caused by this glyph, casting damage for casting it a second time within a one hour period is calculated as if the glyph were three levels higher. No additional mana is used. This effect is cumulative, so a third use of the spell within an hour period would cause casting damage as an 18 mana glyph, and so on!

name: Summon Elemental 'Champion'
verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of ...(A)..., I entreat the elements of Fire, Air, Earth, Water, Light and Darkness. Come forth Champion of ...(A)... let a ...(B)... of ...(A)... appear to do my will.
description: This spell conjures an elemental ‘Champion' to be commanded. An elemental 'Champion' may take 40 hits before being destroyed, inflicts 15pts of damage with its hands and has 10th level Resistances. It will not be negated by being struck by a 4 or 6 mana elemental, only by an 8 mana or higher elemental. All other details are as standard summon elemental, such as Summon Sylph '6'.

name: Aura of Defence
verbal: ...(B)... of ...(A)..., surround my body and defend me against all that seek to strike me!
description: This causes any weapon to be affected by a spell appropriate to the colour of the wizard just before it strikes the caster, no other objects may be affected using this spell. The spell may be one of the following colours with the following effects: Red Green Brown Blue Black Melt* Rust Warp Shatter Disintegrate *In the case of a Red Wizard casting Aura of Defence the melt is instantaneous in effect, but does not inflict damage as does a Melt spell.

name: Ally Darkness
verbal: Shades grant this person the ability to see his foes in the darkness.
description: This spell grants the person it is cast upon the ability to see through magical darkness. Also any Darkness (R) cast upon the target moves with him whilst under the Ally Darkness spell works as though the wizard cast the Darkness (R) spell on himself, i.e. it moves with the recipient.

name: Dark Bolt
verbal: By the power of the shades of the darkest depths I smite thee... Dark bolt!
description: As the Standard 6mp Blue Glyph Lightning Bolt except as detailed above.

name: Kazak's Dark Binding
verbal: By all my power and the powers of darkness I bind this shade into this...
description: Binds a normal Shade 6 (which must have been under the caster's control) into a non-supernatural weapon. Weapon now inflicts +0 black mana damage and may be used to additionally cause Disintegrate (Touch) by blow. The shade bound into the weapon counts as a Shade 6 for dispelling/negating.

name: Ki Black's Engulfing Touch
verbal: Shadows of the night come forth and take this one into your realm...Engulf
description: This spell covers the touched target in a magical shadow. They are held immobile as per a Magical Paralysis. It will end prematurely should the target be placed in Magical Light. The spell, once cast, will hang on the caster’s hands for up to 5 seconds. Immunity to Paralysis applies, and it is considered a listed stopping effect.

name: Sabre of Darkness and Deceit
verbal: Into my hands I call the foulest darkness, blade, hilt and guard I evoke thee to smite the light!
description: This spell creates a sabre of pure darkness that does 12 points of pure magical damage [only DAC and MAC apply]. When used against any goodly aligned or light-based creature it additionally inflicts a 6/1 Blast.to which MAC does not apply (2 Hits). The extra damage will not exceed the user's maximum damage. For example, if it would inflict Double +2 hits (including the blast), even with weapon masteries, etc, the user may only call Quad without additional abilities to increase their max damage. The wielder can also see through magical darkness. The sabre is usable only by the spell caster and whilst he wields it he can also see through magical darkness. This spell is usable only by characters of evil alignment.

name: Shadow Plate
verbal: Shades of the dark I conjure thee, imbue this person's skin with the strength of steel!
description: As per Plate (O) but actually only grants negative Magical Armour Class 5, to a minimum of zero MAC. This spell still grants the 5 points of noncumulative physical armour class (PAC) normally accrued from use of the Plate (O) spell.

name: Shadow Strike
verbal: Feel the anger of the powers of the night and tremble... Shadow Strike!
description: One target takes 18 tblp of purely magical damage (6 Hits), to which MAC applies on a 1 for 1 basis. This spell does not affect those targets in Magical Light.

name: Shadowblade
verbal: Onto this blade I pour darkness, let the real fade and the weird prevail!
description: Causes the weapon the spell is cast upon to lose its physical nature and become purely magical. This means that Physical Armour Class cannot be applied to blows from a weapon so affected – only Dexterity Armour Class and Magical Armour Class may.

name: The Shadows Called
verbal: By all the greatest powers of darkness I bid the shadows linger around thee!
description: Causes the target to be covered in shadows. No matter where they travel they are within a Darkness spell, including the obscuring of vision. This only effects the target and not others around them. ~ 55 ~

name: Zandranas' Droplets of Death
verbal: My dragon spits upon thee... Droplets of Death
description: One target within range is spattered with a droplet of magical venom from directly above. If they are wearing a helmet or similar the venom does not penetrate. Otherwise, the target suffers the effects of a Contact Venom 6, taking 30 seconds to take full effect as normal. This poison is black mana as well as venom, and resistances to either apply.

name: Blade of Decrepitude
verbal: Into my hands I call forth a blade of ancient power, those struck by it - to age and cower. It seeks to make your body old, it wants your essence to fail and fall cold, to it your youth and vigour as food - I summon forth the Blade of Decrepitude
description: This spell summons a bastard sword of negative energy, which unnaturally ages all those it strikes. Every blow struck by the Blade of Decrepitude reduces the target's current and maximum life (TBLP and Locations) by one level for an hour. Immunity to Ageing grants immunity to this effect and Resistance to Black Mana reduces the duration of the ageing effect. The sword inflicts no other damage, and may only be used by the caster. Will generally inflict 2 hits to monsters, although referees are free to amend as they feel appropriate.

name: Cateleptic Touch
verbal: By the power of the shades of dark my touch leaves you to die... Cataleptic Touch
description: Once cast, the wizard has 5 seconds to touch a target, which affects them as if they had suffered a Catalepsy spell at the caster's skill level (e.g. a wizard who has bought 9th level mana and casting would cause a Catalepsy 9 levels by touch with this spell). Note however the decreased duration.

name: Cloak of Shadows
verbal: Let shadow cloak and hide my form from all.
description: May only be cast in an area of heavy shadow or darkness. While the caster remains in these conditions he becomes invisible to normal, physical sight. Should the caster touch a light source, enter an area which is lit by more than weak candlelight, run, attack or cast a spell (or other supernatural power), the spell is broken and he becomes visible.

name: Greater Shadow Plate
verbal: Shades of dark I conjure thee imbue this persons skin with the strength of the darknest steel
description: This spell hangs on the caster’s hands for 5 seconds after being cast. It grants the target non-stacking PAC 10 (in a similar manner to Plate Self), but reduces their MAC by 10 (to a minimum of 0) at the same time. Immunity to Shadow Plate applies. ~ 56 ~

name: Nysh’Aqal’s Passing Plague
verbal: From beneath she devours, mistress of the dark, she hungers for you… Nysh’Aqal’s Plague
description: After 2 minutes, the target will feel ill and have noticeable feelings of nausea; and after 5 minutes this is heightened to the extent that they are deemed at the 5 minute stage of disease (where they are too weak to do anything except breathe and walk slowly; no shouting, casting, fighting, use of DAC, etc). This state lasts for 5 minutes, after which time the Plague passes away. Spiritless Drowe are curiously immune to the effects of this spell.

name: The Disintegration
verbal: By the powers of the shades of dark let there now be a disintegration!
description: All objects which can be disintegrated on the below list which are within line of sight and within 20' are disintegrated as the Disintegrate (R) spell. Note that for the purpose of this spell, living or animate undead creatures do not obstruct line of sight, neither do objects which are disintegrated by this spell. 1: Weapons 2: Armour 3: Shields 4: Potion Bottles 5: Treasure 6: Non supernatural paperwork. This spell does not affect the casting wizard's possessions. It will not affect non-'system relevant' clothing and similar objects – (a rule that applies to all effects in the Labyrinthe system!).

name: Sithantis' Ebon Tendrils
verbal: By all the powers of darkness I ask the Dragon to breath upon that ……!
description: This spell acts as per the disintegrate range spell but functions vs any object that does not contain a spiritual component.

name: Allstarz's Stomach Upset
verbal: Ichor of the dragon taint that ...
description: May only be cast on an item of food or drink, at least the size of a bun or 500ml of liquid. Infuses the item with a magical venom, unnoticeable to normal poison detection abilities. If the item is entirely consumed by one victim within the duration of the spell, they suffer the effects of an Ingestive Death poison, dying unless immune to poison. If even one crumb is not eaten, no ill-effects are suffered. This spell cannot be cast on healing potions of any sort.

name: Anath's Annihilation
verbal: Dragon of darkness I seek a boon, let a life be snuffed by gloom. Let darkness creep and tear and rend, shadow's power break and bend. Lords of Shadow and Lords of Night I send to thee a single life, for by my will and dark creation I now bring forth Annihilation
description: Once this spell is cast, the caster has 5 seconds to touch a target with both hands. If he does not, the spell is wasted. The target is slain and their body disintegrated (this is a particular effect of the spell, since recently dead bodies cannot normally be 'disintegrated'), requiring a Reform spell before they can be restored to life. Immunity to Involuntary Shape Shifting grants complete immunity, and Resistance to Black Mana (1/2 effect) reduces the effects to 5 minutes of unconsciousness (no further resistance applies to this secondary effect). If the target suffers less than half effect from Black Mana, the period of unconsciousness is reduced appropriately and they are awoken from their unconsciousness if struck or harmed. Blue Magic

name: Steal Vitality
verbal: Shadows of the Darkness, Creatures of the Night, I call thee forth to steal this one's might
description: This spell causes the target to have all 'strength' drained from them. Immunity to Strength Drain applies, and 1/2 effect Black Magic means only one grade at most is lost. This spell hangs on the caster’s hand for up to 5 seconds.

name: Void
verbal: May the lords of darkness cast thee down into the nether shadows...Void
description: One target currently within magical darkness is instantly swallowed up by darkness, vanishing completely to reappear in the same spot 5 minutes later. During this time the target finds themselves in a dark void, empty of all things. They come to no harm there, but it is impossible to speak or act in any way unless an ability, such as Divine Guidance, is possessed, in which case shifting powers capable of crossing the planes may be used to return, and abilities such as Improved Message may be used. Immunity to Involuntary Mystical Transportation grants immunity to this spell, unless the target is willing, and white-mana users are also immune, even if willing. Resistance to Black Mana halves the duration of the effect, so that the target reappears after two and a half minutes.

name: Air Dart
verbal: The powers of lightning strike thee... Air Dart
description: Inflicts 6/1 magical lightning damage in the same manner as the Storm Blast spell. Causes 2 hits to monsters.

name: Breeze
verbal: By the Slyphs of Air… Breeze
description: One target within 20’ of the caster is pushed back 20’ by the force of wind.

name: Lightning Shock
verbal: Into my hand I call forth lightning... Lightning Shock
description: Functions as the Red Spell Shock, except that the damage is blue magic lightning and Resistance to Lightning, not fire, applies.

name: Summons
verbal: … I name thee mine, come to me if I should call and require thy aid!
description: This spell requires the wizard to meditate whilst holding the object for 1 minute and then cast the spell, expending 2 mana for each time that he wishes to be able to summon the item. The mana level of the spell for the casting damage is deemed to be the sum of the mana expended. Later the wizard may call "... to me!" at which point the item will blink to his hand which must be held outstretched towards the object. The blink still requires a 2 second phase time as per the 6mp Standard glyph. In addition this spell cannot be cast on an animate object, nor an object larger than 27' cubic feet. Neither may it be cast on an object with more nonmagical metal than a dagger or spearhead, nor on a spiritual object. This spell is learnt as a 2 mana glyph.

name: Thunderous Decree
verbal: Sylphs carry forth my words with great magnitude...
description: This spell causes a phrase of up to seven words spoken by the caster at the end of the verbal to be shouted with tremendous volume. To represent this, the caster may call a Time Freeze in order to shout the phrase. All with Sensitive Hearing within 20' (including the caster) are stunned for 10 seconds, or until struck. This spell may be cast at most once every 15 minutes by the same caster. The phrase shouted may not involve casting in any way (e.g. may not be verbals).

name: Cushion of Air
verbal: Cushion of Air!
description: Creates a resistance in the air within the radius of the spell so that the wizard and any others in the area suffer no falling damage.

name: Forked Lightning
verbal: By all the powers of air and rolling thunder thou art struck and thou art struck!
description: This causes two separate targets that are indicated, to be hit with a Lightning Bolt style effect. If only one target is within range then one of the bolts strikes the wizard. The same person may never be struck twice with the same single casting of this spell. If the only person within range when this spell is cast is the caster himself than one of the bolts is grounded and that bolt inflicts no damage, rather than the wizard being struck twice.

name: Greater Telekinesis
verbal: By the powers of the princes of air, I telekinesise that ... to there!
description: As Telekinesis, but is considered to have 2 grades of strength for moving objects. Can only be used on inanimate objects, or completely motionless animate targets.

name: Gust of Wind
verbal: By the powers of the sylphs of air... Gust of Wind!
description: All those within a 60‘ cone and within 10' of the caster are thrown 20' back by the force of the wind created by this spell. Immunity to Repels grants immunity to the effect.

name: Mustrum's Instantaneous Blink
verbal: Blink!
description: As per the basic Blue spell of Blink but with the above differences. The use of this spell causes the caster the loss of a casting level for the following hour.

name: Skin of Air
verbal: Sylphs of air bide here a time.
description: The recipient of the spell is surrounded with a thin shell of pure air. This air is constantly replenished for the spell's duration, thus allowing the recipient to breathe, regardless of exterior interference - for example they may breathe underwater or where there is no air. Non-supernatural gasses and liquids are completely displaced by this spell, so that underwater the recipient will not even get wet. They are also shielded from the detrimental effects of gas clouds or similar, or other exterior effects which are based on breathing. However the spell is not capable of resisting forceful attacks, so could not prevent a jet of acid fired at the caster, or similar. As a side-effect it becomes impossible to use the Sniff (Discern Smell) skill while under the effects of this spell, nor Locational Sniff. This spell may be acquired for 40 points, which covers both the 3mp (Self) and 4mp (Other) variants. If for any reason the recipient of the spell would be harmed by it, the spell fails to no effect.

name: Su's Mass Blink
verbal: By the greater powers of Air - let us all be taken there...Mass Blink
description: This spell causes all those who are willing and touching the caster to be 'blinked' - as per the Blink spell - Each person arrives in the position /arrangement that they left from. This spell costs 10 mana +1 per person affected. Casting damage is calculated as a 10th level spell plus 1tblp per additional person. This spell is learnt as a 10th level spell. ~ 58 ~

name: Thunder Clap
verbal: Sylphs show us thy power! Thunderclap X levels
description: This spell causes a sudden crack of thunder, centred on one target within hearing range who can be seen, stunning and deafening them. The target suffers the effects of a magical Halt spell of the 'skill level' of the caster, e.g. 9 levels if wizard has 9th Level Mana and Casting on tables, and is additionally deafened for 5 minutes. This of course makes them immune to further repetitions of the same spell. Immunity to Halt or stopping effects applies to the stunning.

name: Thunderbolt
verbal: By all the powers of air and thunder, let power be sundered – I shatter this ....
description: As per Shatter but will affect objects with a magical component. Will not function on other supernatural objects such as spiritual weapons. Can be mended as normal by use of a Mend spell as the magic remains in the object. However if an 'item' or similar, its powers cannot be commanded while it is not whole. Cannot be used on Wall spells or similar!

name: Displacement
verbal: May the lords of air grasp that “object” and carry it from there to here
description: Causes one object that does not contain a spirit to be shifted from its present location to the caster’s hands.

name: Hurricane
verbal: I call upon the mighty lords of the air to create a vortex to protect me, reap the whirlwind... Hurricane!
description: This spell effectively creates a circular barrier at a distance of 10' from the caster, which is immobile. The barrier is opaque and impassable by any creature with a physical or magical form due to the incredible high speed of the winds spinning around the focal point. Recipients of the Ivory Mobility spell or similar may pass this barrier as it is deemed to be a stopping/slowing effect. Determination, War-Cries and similar abilities are not sufficient to allow passage.

name: Intelligent Dancing Sword
verbal: Lords of air I implore thee, lend me thy aid and let this sword dance to my will!
description: Exactly as the 8mp Handbook Blue Glyph Dancing Sword but the caster does not need to concentrate on the sword, although he is required to be able to view the blade at all times for it to be active. If he cannot see the sword it stands floating in the air, inactive until he can see it again. The damage delivered by the sword is 24 magic points rather than the 18 points usually delivered by a Dancing Sword. This spell cannot be further enhanced by any means, e.g. not via poison, Blackblade, et cetera. A wizard may not have more than one Intelligent Dancing Sword active at any time, nor may any elementals be under the control of the wizard, or both spells are cancelled. A Dancing Sword and an Intelligent Dancing Sword may never be grappled with and forced to the ground as they are extremely nimble and sharp edged – so do not try! ~ 59 ~

name: Plane Shift
verbal: By the power of the lords of the sylphs, let me be taken 'twixt worlds, to ...
description: Transports the caster to the corresponding point on a different plane 'of his choice', meaning that the caster must either have been previously to that plane, or have sufficient knowledge of it at the ref's discretion. This may not of course be used to go to 'the plane of Total Heal and Magical Bastard-swords', or similar! A wizard who has bought this glyph may begin to keep a 'visited list' of planes visited, signed by the referee of each adventure, in the same manner as a Sniff list. If this is not done, the referee is at liberty to declare the wizard's knowledge insufficient to travel anywhere but to Labyrinthia. Note that this spell only transports the caster to the corresponding point on the plane of choice, not where he wishes to go.

name: Storm Caller
verbal: By the greater powers of the Storms, Air and Thunder I call to the fury of the Winds to strike down those before me...
description: This spell allows the caster to cast the Storm Blast spell at will for 0 mana for the duration. However, the caster takes 1tblp damage, which is unreduceable and unavoidable per casting. Full verbal for the Storm Blast spell must be used each time, and it may not be cast at a rate greater than 1/10 seconds. Disadvantage: The casting of this spell causes the caster to lose one casting level for the next hour.

name: Teleport
verbal: May the greater powers of air, teleport me to...
description: As 6 mana point Standard spell Blink in all manners except the range is anywhere on the wizard's current plane of existence, even if it is out of line of sight with the following restrictions: The wizard must have seen, on this adventure, the destination before, have the destination within line of sight, live there (i.e. a location not involved with the adventure which may be known as the wizard's home) or have memorised the location. It costs 5pts post 8th to memorise a location other than home, per location memorised. The referee of the location must have signed the ability onto your character card. If you have a location signed onto your card and are on an adventure not being run by the same referee who signed the location onto your card, then the is within their rights to disallow that location as a point to which you may teleport. In case of dispute, the player is assumed to have teleported home. This spell is affected by the Advanced Grey spell of Phase Trap, which is described under Grey Magic in The Advanced Grimoire, starting on page 73. If this glyph is used twice within an hour, the stresses on the body are such that the caster takes casting damage as if the glyph were two levels higher. This applies to multiple uses, so that a third time in an hour the casting damage would be calculated as four levels higher, and so on. This in no way increases the actual mana cost of the spell. This rule applies to Mass Teleport, Plane Shift, and Mass Plane Shift below, plus Elemental 'Port above, and to combined castings of any of these spells.

name: The Shattering
verbal: By the powers of the sylphs of air let there be a universal shattering!
description: All objects which can be shattered on the below list which are within line of sight and within 20' are shattered as the Shatter (R) spell. Note that for the purpose of this spell living or animate undead creatures do not obstruct line of sight, neither do objects which are shattered by this spell. 1. Weapons 2. Armour 3. Shields 4. Potion Bottles 5. Treasure 6. Non supernatural paperwork. This spell does not affect normal clothing, nor any of the casting wizard's possessions.

name: George's Grand Banishment
verbal: Mighty powers of the air, in the name of the Voice of the Dragon I bid thee take this one away with thee on thy travels! Banishment".
description: The target touched with both hands within 5 seconds of reciting the spell is involuntarily Teleported away, and on reappearing in a random location is immediately re-Teleported before fully phasing in. This repeats for the full duration of the spell. Effectively any target not Immune to Involuntary Mystical Transportation spells is rendered completely unable to act or be affected by exterior sources for 24 hours. However 1/2 effect blue mana (or magic) generally halves the duration of the effect, and so on.

name: George’s Vacuum
verbal: By the will of the lord of air and the power of the storms I call forth the breath from your body, may the air within your body be dragged forth!
description: The spell causes all the air in the targets lung to be drawn rapidly from them, causes extreme damage to their lungs. This acts as per a sever (which inflicts sufficient damage to sever the location based on its current health) to the target’s abdomen. Resistances to sever/loc to zero apply as normal, while resistances to / 1/2 effect blue mana reduce the damage suffered. Additionally Large Lung Capacity acts as an additional resistance to sever. This is a flesh and blood effect and does not work on most elves (as they do not breathe). It does work on air elves.

name: Mass Plane Shift
verbal: By the power of the lords of the sylphs, may they grasp these people and take them 'twixt worlds to ...
description: As per Plane Shift but the wizard may take extra willing people with him at the additional cost of 1 mana point and 1 life point each. See Teleport above for additional restrictions on casting this glyph.

name: Mass Teleport
verbal: May the greatest powers of air grasp these people and take them there/to...
description: As per Teleport but the wizard may take extra willing people with him at the additional cost of 1 mana point and 1 life point each. See Teleport above for restrictions.

name: Empower Voice
verbal: Mighty bronze drake let your power flow through me.
description: For the next Power Word spell used by the caster within the spell's duration, their skill level is considered to be one higher.

name: Involuntary Gesture
verbal: By the Drake I command thee ........
description: This simple spell causes the target to momentarily perform one otherwise inconsequential action. Such as twitching, slightly moving their foot, shrugging their shoulders, blinking or similar. This action can have no other 'in-game' effect. The successful use of the spell will reveal whether the target is Immune to Bronze Mana Domination effects or not. This spell effect is not level based, and only works on animate living creatures. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Power Word "Fear"
verbal: By the might of the Bronze Drake... Fear X levels
description: This spell only affects the target if it has a resistance level lower than the wizard's skill level (not casting level) as measured by the zero mana Bronze cantrip Tell Strength. In addition, this spell will only affect living creatures that are vulnerable to magical effects. Apart from where detailed above this spell is identical to the evil miracle Cause Fear. It is also a Domination Effect. ~ 60 ~

name: Power Word "Trip"
verbal: By the might of the Bronze Drake... Trip X levels!
description: This spell only affects the target if it has a resistance level lower than the wizard's skill level (not casting level) as measured by the zero mana Bronze cantrip Tell Strength. In addition, this spell will only affect living creatures that are vulnerable to magical effects. The target of a Power Word Trip will fall to the ground and be unable to rise for 2 seconds. This spell requires no object for the target to trip over, unlike the grey 2 mana point spell. This is a Domination Effect and Immunity to Trip also applies.

name: Empower Corpse
verbal: By the Might of the Bronze Drake I command thee Corpse! Act as my servant and follow my words. Arise!
description: This spell causes a touched corpse of a creature that in animance was affected by magic to arise. The creature becomes animate to the extent that it will follow the commands of the caster exactly. It retains no powers from its animance, since it is the Bronze magic which causes it to move. The Corpse has the caster’s base Wizardly skill level in locational hits, and x3 of that in general hits. It automatically gains a single grade of strength, and may use any physical weapon given to it. The Corpse clearly has no mind or spirit. It sees with normal physical sight. This spell has no effect on the life and death status of the corpse for purposes of resurrection, etc.

name: Enslavement
verbal: The Bronze Drake is now your Master! I place thee under Enslavement
description: This spell causes the nominated target to stop whatever there were doing, and become completely motionless. The target can do nothing else, and otherwise is not under the control of the caster. This spell only affects creatures below the Wizards Skill Level, [e.g. 9th level mana and casting]. Should the target suffer any form of damage then they are immediately freed from the spell. This is a Domination Effect and not a stopping effect.

name: Incite Mania
verbal: May the Bronze Drake cloud your mind and cause all before you to be your foe!
description: Clouds the target’s mind and causes them to view everyone as a potential foe. This grants them a berserker’s attitude to combat, meaning that once combat has begun they will attack anyone that is hostile/aggressive. This affects targets below the caster’s skill level, and Immunity to Insanity applies.

name: Limb Stun
verbal: By the Bronze Drake let thy________ be stunned!
description: The nominated limb of the target is struck useless. If an arm, anything held in it is dropped. If a leg, the target cannot put weight on it [much as if it were broken, or you had a dead leg] for the duration of the spell. This is considered a Listed Stopping Effect.

name: Persuasive Suggestion
verbal: By the majesty of the Bronze Drake I suggest that you [specified command].... Suggestion
description: This spell acts in all ways as per a magical Beguile Spirit, except limited to only the command specified in the verbal, which may be no longer than 3 words. This spell affects targets that have a resistance level to Bronze Magic lower than the caster's skill level. This is a Domination Effect. It should be noted that, as per Beguile, it is unlikely someone would just lie down to be beaten to death through the use of this spell.

name: Power Word "Awaken"
verbal: By the might of the bronze drake... Awaken X levels!
description: The target is 'awoken' from any magical or physical stopping effects that they may be suffering from. This is a Domination Effect and affects targets of less than the caster's skill level only.

name: Power Word "Die"
verbal: By the might of the Bronze Drake... Die!
description: This spell affects a living target that is affected by magical effects. This spell causes the target to fall over unconscious as if dead until the end of the spell's duration or until struck. It is considered a listed stopping effect, and additionally a Domination effect. It will only work on creatures below the wizards skill level.

name: Vertigo
verbal: By the might of the bronze drake feel sickness... Vertigo X levels
description: One target of below the caster's skill level feels the sick queasiness of vertigo whenever away from contact with the ground. As such they will not voluntarily use any form of flight power, and if lifted off the ground by another source they will perform no rational action other than to try to return to the ground. This is a Domination Effect.

name: Word of Command
verbal: Fool obey the Bronze drake and…..
description: This spell acts as per the miracle Voice of Power (except for the duration). It affects targets below the caster’s skill level.

name: Wracking Pain
verbal: By the power of the Bronze Drake I smite thee down... Wracking Pain!
description: This spell causes the target to be struck down with pain as per the Words of Pain spell, although the caster need not continue talking to maintain it. The target suffers 6/1 damage (2 hits) and can take no action other than writing on the floor in agony until the spell expires or they are struck or harmed. Resistances to Words of Pain apply to both the damage and the incapacitating effect, but this is not a stopping effect.

name: Control Automaton
verbal: By the Might of the Bronze Drake I command you. Hear my voice and follow my commands, I am your master now
description: This spell acts to control one mindless creature made by magic, typically magical statues, elementals and the like. The creature will do nothing except follow the commands of the caster. It has no control or will of its own, to the extent that it will follow any command given to it by the caster to the best of its talents.

name: Greater Shudder
verbal: The might of the Drake, will cause your body to shake, tremble and fail under my power...Greater Shudder.
description: The target of the spell suffers a drop in Dexterity armour class of 12 points, caused by uncontrollable shakes. This can negate Physical armour class, but will not drop the total armour class below 0. If this is cast on a monster then it decreases the monsters hits by 24, though typically monsters will be set with AC - and it is from that that the AC will be deducted. The minimum number of hits that a monster can be left with is 1, as clearly this spell cannot kill, but merely increase the amount of damage that the victim receives during combat. Immunity to Dexterity Drain or Immunity to Domination Effects applies.

name: Power Word "Frenzy"
verbal: By the might of the Bronze Drake... Frenzy!
description: This spell only affects living creatures that are affected by magical effects. The Power Word Frenzy grants the target a non-cumulative 25% reduction to all damage after armour class. This reduction does not stack with similar percentile reductions, but does take priority, even if the target would normally have a higher or alternative damage reduction, such as a Berserker's rage ability. Whilst in this frenzy they may only strike melee blows and may not leave a fight nor stop fighting, though he may choose one immediate target over another. A frenzied monster increases his hits by one third. This is a Domination effect, and only works on targets below the wizard skill level.

name: Powerword “Suicide”
verbal: By the will of the bronze drake I bid my words and touch carry you to take your own life!
description: The spell affects targets 2 levels below the caster’s skill level, or lower. It causes the target to attempt to perform any and all actions they can to kill themselves. While the spell is active they are unable to cast (as per Thrall spell). Immunity to Spiritual Mastery applies. Brown Magic

name: Bridge of Stone
verbal: Gnomes of the earth I conjure thee, build for me a bridge of stone!
description: Creates a slab of stone similar to a Wall of Stone in many ways, except that it stretches almost horizontally across from one point of earth to another. The maximum dimensions of the bridge are 10' wide, 1' thick, and up to 40' long. It must have solid ground at either end to anchor to.

name: Earth Tremor
verbal: Mighty gnomes of earth twist and shake this place such that my foes are toppled.
description: This causes all creatures within 20' to fall to the floor. The Tables ability Stability grants immunity to this spell.

name: Lightning Rod
verbal: Gnome lords, I am as one with the earth - let the lightning dissipate into your depths.
description: As long as the caster does not move from the spot, all ranged electrical attacks which pass within 20' are drawn to strike him (and no other target). The caster also gains MAC 6 versus electrical attacks only. If the caster moves this effect is disturbed but if within the duration he should spend 10 seconds standing in one spot the effect resumes. ~ 62 ~

name: Linear Accelerator
verbal: Mighty gnomes of earth take this person in your grasp and hurl him there!
description: This spell enables the wizard to propel a person in metal armour as though a successful Jump (O) spell, regardless of whether the target had been willing, had been successfully cast on them. It doesn't matter if the armour is of magic supernatural origin, although spiritual armour is immune to this spell. Immunity to Involuntary Mystical Transportation does not apply to this effect, as the armour is being targeted not the character.

name: Magnetic Repulsion
verbal: May the powers of earth draw metals away! Magnetic Repulsion
description: All non-spiritual metals within 20' are hurled back to the edge of the radius of effect. Creatures holding metal objects may choose to be thrown back with the object, or to let go of it. Those wearing metal armour, even studded leather, are thrown back and Immunity to Repels or similar may not be applied to this as it is the objects, not the character, which are being affected.

name: Earth Shield
verbal: Mighty Gnomes of earth shield me from all magic!
description: This spell grants the wizard total immunity to all forms of magic, including dispels to remove this glyph. Note: if cast by a magical creature such as an Elf, Drave or Faerie, the creature instantly dies and if cast mantically by a creature with a spirit, that creature also instantly dies. Whilst this spell is running the wizard may not use spells or magical items or benefit from any source of magic.

name: Earthern Encasement
verbal: Earth I bid thee rise, encase and entrap this one... Encasement
description: The target, who must be standing on earthen or stone ground, sinks into the earth up to their knees, affecting them in a manner similar to Bind, except that no footwear is required. As this spell simply changes the shape of the ground in a manner similar to Reshape it cannot be dispelled, but 40 Hits with a blunt weapon, or 5 minutes activity with a sharp weapon to the ground around the target's feet will free them, as will a Reshape spell. In the same way as Bind, this is not a listed stopping effect, because the effect does not as such stop the character but only shapes the floor around them (in a similar way, Bind does not affect the character, only their footwear or other object targeted).

name: Gravity Well
verbal: May the lords of earth bring thee to thy knees...Gravity Well!
description: This spell acts similarly to a Magnetise spell on an animate target with legs. The target does not have to be carrying any metal. The target must be in contact with the ground in order to be affected, but once affected cannot leave contact with earth, and is forced to their knees. Whilst held by a Gravity Well to the ground a target will be unable to benefit from dexterity armour class. A character who possesses 1/2 effect brown mana is not forced to their knees, but still loses 1/2 of their dexterity armour class.

name: Great Missile
verbal: Mighty lords of the earth, infuse this rock with all thy power... Great Missile
description: As Supermissile, except that the damage inflicted is 18 points to the location, 3pts to each other location, and 36 tblp overall (12 general hits to monsters).

name: Greater Stone Skin
verbal: I call upon the gnomes of earth to imbue my skin with the strength of stone
description: This spell is as per Stoneskin [Self] but confers +6 PAC and +6 Max AC [maximum 12] to the caster. They additionally become Immune to Bruising versus PAC.

name: Mass Bind
verbal: May theLlords of Earth bind thee all!
description: Causes all creatures within the area to suffer the effects of a Bind spell.

name: Meld with Stone
verbal: Gnomes of earth take me in your embrace and hide me from sight.
description: This spell draws the wizard into the earth upon which he is standing and, for the duration of the spell, the wizard is deemed not to exist except for any purpose bar observation. The wizard may perceive during this time but cannot prematurely end the spell, nor take any other actions. A Dispel Magic of the appropriate level from an external source will end the spell and eject the wizard from the earth, however, as the ground where the wizard vanished radiates magic. Whilst under the effects of this spell, no time passes for the caster; as such, any effects they were under when they enter the ground pause until they are released from it. This applies to both beneficial and disadvantageous effects.

name: Thomasss' Lesser Earthern Warding
verbal: Mighty Gnomes of Earth protect my body- Shelter thy servant from the ravages of the World
description: Against the next 3 blows suffered within the duration the caster counts as though they had a Rockskin spell active. This spell is ended once all three blows have been suffered.

name: Tower of Stone
verbal: Mighty Gnomes of Earth, Princes of Rock build for me a Tower of Stone
description: This creates, in the same manner as a Wall of Stone, a circular Wall of Stone. It has a 10’ radius and surrounds the point indicated by the caster. The wall is immobile, 1ft thick, and up to 40ft high.

name: Walk through Walls
verbal: Lords of Earth allow me thy servant, passage through your world for a while
description: This spell allows the caster to 'walk through walls' made of earth or stone for the duration. There is 2 seconds of disorientation when emerging as normal (cf. Walk through Walls). When in any wall, can only cast touch and self spells unless has active mana / mage / elemental sight. ~ 63 ~

name: Form of Steel
verbal: Mighty gnomes of earth protect my body. Let my flesh to turned to metal, let my body harden so that diamonds will not cut. May my body be as Steel.
description: Causes the targets flesh to harden and become as strong as steel. This causes them to be reduced to maximum damage zero as they cannot effectively wield a weapon in combat. Additionally they may only move at ½ speed. However, while active they are impervious to all weapon blows with a physical component. This is an aura of defence. Ebony Magic

name: Hammer of Might
verbal: Mighty gnomes of the earth, let thy smashing force humble the foe... Hammer of Might!
description: Creates a stone hammer or mace filled with earth magic, such that it does not inflict normal damage by blow but instead causes damage equivalent to a standard unenhanced (including by Expertise) Magic Missile spell, every blow. Additionally, if a two-handed weapon is summoned (caster's choice), the caster may cause a 10' Knockback effect instead of damage, at will. Only the casting wizard may use this weapon.

name: Jaynus' Juddering
verbal: Let the earth shake and the gnomes show their anger! Let none stand before their might!
description: For the next 5 minutes the earth in a 10' radius around the caster begins to tremor and shake, in a manner similar to repeated Earth Tremors, so that it is impossible to stand upright. Those within the radius may for example roll across the ground, and swing weapons from a prone position, but may not even briefly stand. The Walk on Earth spell, Neuromastery Earth or Stability grant immunity to the effect, but otherwise the caster is equally affected.

name: Rockskin
verbal: Mighty gnomes of earth protect my body, I now seek the might of thy granite, armour my body such that thy servant may enter this fray and wield thy power for the glory of Earth, my skin is as diamond, my muscle as Rock... Rockskin!
description: The caster suffers very limited levels of damage from any weapon which has a physical component, e.g.: a normal weapon, a magical and physical weapon, a spiritual and physical weapon. The actual damage suffered is equal to 1pt per damage grade, as listed below. This spell provides no protection to ranged spell attacks, or from purely magical attacks, or from purely spiritual attacks, or neuronics, nor from attacks enhanced by earth power evocations. If you are uncertain whether the spell will protect you then assume that it will not. The protections offered by this spell do not stack with any other defences including distancing combat, Plate (S), normal armour class, rages, numeric damage reductions or anything which reduces the damage you take. The best protection is assumed to be taken between the rock skin and whatever other defences are owned by the wizard. Grade Single Double Triple Quad Quin Original Damage 1pt to 6pts 7pts to 12pts 13pts to 18pts 19pts to 24pts 25pts to 30pts Net Damage 1pt 2pts 3pts 4pts 5pts

name: Super Plate (Other)
verbal: May the gnomes of the earth imbue this person’s skin with the strength of Adamantium!
description: This spell grants the recipient magic and physical armour class to his maximum armour class or 10, whichever is lower. Super Plate (Self) must be known by the caster as a prerequisite to buying this glyph. Alternatively, both glyphs may be bought together for 100 points.

name: Super Plate (Self)
verbal: May the gnomes of the earth imbue my skin with the strength of Adamantium!
description: This spell grants the caster magic and physical armour class to his maximum armour class or 10, whichever is higher.

name: Svelt's Baffling Aura of Anti-Magnetic Force
verbal: Gnomes of earth I conjure thee, let your force surround me and metals be turned away from vulnerable flesh. May the power of the lode-stone shield me from base iron.
description: The caster is suddenly surrounded by an invisible aura that repels metal objects from him. As a result it is impossible for the caster to hold metal objects for the duration, and if they were wearing armour with metal in it, even studded leather, it is ripped apart and forced away from their body, becoming useless. However, this repelling effect also applies to metal weapons, so that non-spiritual metal weapons are unable to strike the caster, instead being turned away an inch from his body. Immunity to Opponent's Aura of Defence applies to those trying to strike the caster, but not to the caster himself.

name: Aching Heart
verbal: May your Heart be broken by these words
description: This spell allows the next 'Pain' spell [2 mana] to be cast by the Wizard to be altered slightly such that it targets the victim's chest as well as TBLP. As such it will inflict 12 TBLP and 12pts to the chest. Resistances to Ebony Mana and Resistances to Pain, etc, apply as normal.

name: See through Mists
verbal: May the Ebony Drake grant me the power to see through another's Mists.
description: This enables the wizard to see through a mist spell cast by another ebony wizard only, and any form of natural mist. ~ 64 ~

name: Agony
verbal: May the ebony Drake strike thee with Agony!
description: As the 2 mana point Ebony Spell Pain, but it inflicts 18pts of TBLP damage. As with the Pain spell, this spell does not harm those creatures unable to feel pain, such as elementals, true undead, statues and plants.

name: Ebony Assassin
verbal: May the drake grant my arm power and let this weapon strike deep!
description: The next blow within five minutes that the caster strikes with the specified weapon, may inflict up to Quin damage (this is the damage limit not the actual increase in damage given by the spell) and gains +6pts of physical damage.

name: Enhanced Spell Shield
verbal: Let magic go awry and the elements be baffled.
description: Only benefits a caster with a Spell Shield glyph currently active. All ranged magical effects aimed at the caster miss by scant inches, as ebony power misleads the magic as to the location of the target, granting the caster complete immunity to them. However while this is active the caster may not use ranged magical abilities. The only exception to this is that any Dispel Magic aimed at the caster will 'strike' only this Enhanced Spell Shield, and if the Dispel is of sufficient potency then this glyph will be negated. Use of this spell costs a casting level for 1 hour. This spell does not protect against area effects.

name: Evasion
verbal: I travel this way unseen by magic!
description: This spell allows the caster to 'evade' a static magical effect, typically a 'line' or warding - In a similar way to the Ghost Scout skill. The caster is able to cross the line without triggering its effects. This is a one-shot use and further transgressions will trigger the warding / effect.

name: Forget
verbal: Let mist cloud thy thoughts... Forget!
description: The target instantly forgets the events of the last 30 seconds, as per the neuronic power of the same name. Immunity to Forget applies and Resistance to Ebony Mana reduces the amount of memory lost.

name: Pain Blade
verbal: May the Ebony Drake cause this blade to twist and pain my foe!
description: This spell causes the wizard's dagger blade (only) to cause an extra 6pts of damage when it strikes the target, against which no armour class applies, although resistances to the 2mp Ebony spell Pain do. This spell does not help the wizard in any way if the called damage is quad already or higher (the effects of subtle pain are lost with such mighty blows). I.e. the maximum damage that may be called remains unchanged. This spell may not be cast on a blade which is already enhanced by any other means, e.g. poison, Fireblade, +0 Magic, spiritual, et cetera.

name: Torment
verbal: May the ebony Drake strike thee down with great Torment!
description: As the 2 mana point Ebony Spell Pain, but it inflicts 36pts of TBLP damage. As with the Pain spell, this spell does not harm those creatures unable to feel pain, such as elementals, true undead, statues and plants.

name: Trick of the Ear
verbal: Drake, let my speech ring out as they would wish it.
description: The next time the caster speaks will be heard by any within hearing expecting a password or phrase as that phrase. Targets that are immune to Domination effects are not deceived, but this spell will even affect magical traps and wardings, such as the Gold spell Forcewall, or other non-standard magical barriers with passwords, thereby triggering the password condition. This in no way grants the caster knowledge of the appropriate phrase, however, so the spell must be repeated if there is a need to repeat the phrase. It does not, of course, deceive similar spiritual barriers or traps, or those immune to magic.

name: Trick of the Eye
verbal: May Ebon mists rise and confound your sight
description: Causes the target’s vision to become obscured and confused. This prevents them using any ranged effects beyond a distance of 10ft. Enhanced Perception grants immunity, as does Immunity to Blindness. ~ 65 ~

name: Willocks Baffling Shield
verbal: Let Ebon power conceal this object from those that seek knowledge of it
description: Causes the target object (not animate) to gain benefits of a Spell Shield. Clearly this does not work with Enhanced Spell Shield.

name: Change Appearance
verbal: May the Ebony drake twist and turn my very form, a veil on my body I now do draw may my appearance be that of a ...[race]...
description: This spell changes the visual appearance of the caster to any one named race, which the caster has seen before. If a race with a makeup restriction is to be changed, this does not mean he can omit the face paint, etc. of his original race, although it might be acceptable for him to be disguised as another non-human with appropriate face paint, etc. The amount of makeup coverage should remain the same, e.g. a full elf = full coverage, a 1/2 elf = 1/2 coverage, etc. This may be cast before adventure, but whilst the spell is active the caster may not recover the mana spent on conjuring it. Therefore, if cast before the adventure begins the wizard must still battleboard the mana and associated life cost.

name: Doubt
verbal: Your nerves be broken and your voice to lose its shout, my Ebony power will fill your mind with doubt!
description: This target of the spell is filled with doubt over their actions, losing purpose and will to proceed, becoming lacklustre and unsure of what they should be doing. In game terms the spell has 3 effects: 1: Target loses 1 level of resistance 2: Target cannot use any melee ability that requires any form of concentration or skill, including Weapon Masteries / Force Majeure / Accuracy / +X on Nth Strike abilities / Knockbacks / Knockdowns. 3: Target is unable to apply any form of Determination or War Cry style ability [e.g. Discipline]. This spell only works on living creatures affected by Emotional Attacks, and is additionally a Domination Effect, as per Confusion. Immunity to Loss of Weapon Masteries applies separately to that facet of the spell.

name: Greater Escape
verbal: Ebony Drake, take me home!
description: This spell has two subtly different variants, the first returning the caster to their home in a manner similar to Word of Recall, whether across planes or similar, or otherwise prevented from normally shifting. The second, however, functions in all ways bar casting cost as the glyph Escape, but uses the above verbal.

name: Pass Unnoticed
verbal: May ebony power turn attention from me - let me pass unseen, unheard and out of the ken of all.
description: For the duration the caster will not be noticed by any creature unless they are completely mindless, e.g. animated statues, zombies, etc, as the attention of all is distracted away from him. Creatures immune to magic of course are also unaffected by this. Perception, Sense Motion and True Sight also grant immunity, but otherwise no creature is able to see, smell, hear or otherwise become aware of the caster. However, the spell is broken should the caster speak, run, attack, or touch another creature - although within the duration, if the spell is broken and the caster then spends 30 seconds completely motionless the spell takes effect once more.

name: The Ebon Claw
verbal: Ebony Drake, creature of pain, wild powers unfettered and raw, strike down this fool, with thy Ebon Claw.
description: This spell requires a 2-handed touch to the target within 5 secs of completing the verbal. It inflicts 48tblp damage as per Pain, and causes the target to be held in suffering, unable to act for a further 10seconds as per a stasis, against which immunities/resistances to Pain also apply.

name: The Forgettance
verbal: With Ebon power I cast your life in the mists of the forgotten. Let your very being fade from existence and be as nothing.
description: The target of the spell is forgotten by the world and instantly dies. Any target with vitae partially resists this spell and only falls unconscious for 5 minutes. ½ effect ebony mana also means the person is only rendered unconscious for 5 minutes. If both are possessed then the target is only unconscious for two and a half minutes. Immunity to Forget grants complete immunity to the spell. ~ 66 ~

name: Attraction
verbal: The Gold Drake attracts thee!
description: As per the 10mp spell Warding but attracts back one target a total of 40' (14 paces), regardless of the number of hits/levels of resistance that it possesses. Target is stopped by contact with solid objects, at which point the target is released. This spell only functions on Marked Allies.

name: Callum's Gateway
verbal: Forces of Magic, Golden Friend, I wish to open the door, but not with the spell to end - I speak in friendship with this well chosen word...[password]...
description: This spell will open a doorway in any Gold Magic spell that can be lowered by the use of a Password. The door way will open once and close once per casting of this spell. The doorway will remain open at most for 5 minutes before resealing itself. Speaking the password backwards can reseal it. As indicated within the verbal it is necessary for the caster to know the password in order to open the doorway.

name: Courage
verbal: May the Golden Drake fill thy heart with courage!
description: This spell grants the target immunity to all forms of non-spiritual fear for the spell's duration.

name: Endurance
verbal: May the Drake grant stamina to my allies... Endurance
description: This grants the target an extra 18 TBLP, as per the Ivory warrior spell. Against a Traitor it reduces their TBLP maximum by twice this amount, i.e. 36 TBLP. Effects such as permanent damage are taken from this temporary life firs,t so possibly vanishing at the end of the duration. This spell does not stack with itself or any other effect which grants temporary extra life, e.g. Enhance Spirit, Adrenal Surge, et cetera.

name: Find Ally
verbal: May the gold drake guide me to thee ... my ally.
description: Grants the caster knowledge of the location of one named Marked Ally, if anywhere on the same plane. If on another plane, the caster is aware of this but nothing else. The caster is also aware of the general state of the Ally, e.g. unconscious, dead, badly injured, fine, etc. Immunity to Informational Spells grants immunity to this spell.

name: Greater Shield Other
verbal: May the Gold Drake shield and ward my/your body with all his might.
description: As the Shield glyph, but grants instead +6 PAC and MAC to the recipient, who must be a Marked Ally. This spell does not stack with Shield Self or other spells.

name: Greater Shield Self
verbal: May the Gold Drake shield and ward my/your body with all his might.
description: As the Shield glyph, but grants instead +6 PAC and MAC to the recipient, who must be a Marked Ally. This spell does not stack with Shield Self or other spells.

name: Mass Repulsion
verbal: The Gold Drake repels thee all!
description: All creatures within 10' of the caster are hurled back 40' or until their travel is blocked by a solid object, in a similar manner to Repulsion. This spell does not affect marked allies.

name: Personal Haven
verbal: Golden Drake I require rest and shelter - I seek peace and tranquillity in this place
description: As per the Haven spell, but the only person affected by the spell and its Pacification effect is the caster. The spell grants a temporary version of Greater Aware Meditation [see Post 8th tables for details]. The spell lasts as long as the casting wizard remains within the area of affect [30' radius], during which time the wizard counts as though meditating and gains +x1 Meditation Rate [non-stacking with any other temporarily increase].

name: Repulsion
verbal: The Gold Drake repels thee!
description: As per the 10mp spell Warding but flings back one target a total of 40' (14 paces) regardless of the number of hits/levels of resistance that it possesses. Target is stopped by contact with solid objects, at which point the target is released.

name: Shield Blessing
verbal: The Gold Drake fills this shield with power, to guard and ward you.
description: One normal, non-supernatural shield in the hands of a Marked Ally or self becomes +0 magical and capable of blocking purely magical weapon blows for the duration. In addition it grants +2 MAC versus ranged magical attacks when held in the direction of the attack. Despite the spell's title it is not a Bless.

name: Bliss and Euphoria
verbal: The Gold Drake offers you a choice, accept his touch and be filled with wonderment, Bliss and Euphoria.
description: This spell is an emotion attack that places the target into a state of extreme contentment. It makes the target immune to all other non-spiritual: Emotion attacks, and Insanities. Whilst active the target may not attack except in purest self defence.

name: Chernobyl's Lesser Force-Trap
verbal: The Gold Drake holds thee in the palm of his hand... Force-Trap.
description: This surrounds the target in a 'skin' of gold force similar to a Forcewall spell, making it impossible for them to move or speak, unless they are able to walk through magical walls, or shift without speech. The skin allows air to penetrate, so that the creature inside may breathe, and also may free themselves if they can enter a Gaseous Form. Any blows directed at the target will first strike this skin and be blocked by it, although 20 magical Hits will destroy it, freeing the target. Alternatively, the spell is released with the same command word the caster's Forcewall spells are keyed to.

name: Golden Golem
verbal: May the Gold Drake protect my form. Ward my body from the blows of all - I go forwards in the name of peace - I call forth the Armour of the Golden Golem".
description: This spell creates an aura around the caster of magical golden magic. Any weapon without a spiritual component is stopped by its warding style magic before it strikes the caster, causing no effect whatsoever to the caster. Unarmed combat by creatures with a spirit still hits, and in a similar manner the caster [should they have a spirit] is still able to touch others. The Golden Golem aura is broken by the caster should they move faster than a slow walk or use any melee attack. Immunity to Opponent’s Aura of Defence applies.

name: Haven
verbal: Golden Drake your children require time to rest and recover, wounds need attention, and mana grows short!
description: Within the radius of effect all creatures that are not mindless feel at ease. None may initiate any conflict or carry on if the fight enters the area of affect, or if the target is in the area of effect. I.e. you cannot attack into the area. Any creature which is not completely immune to magic that tries to enter the area of affect, but who is not affected by the pacification above, will find themselves unable to do so (e.g. mindless creatures like animated statues or similar). If any conflict occurs within the haven, the spell is cancelled immediately, e.g. if a purely spiritual creature attacks a creature who is affected by the spell and is within the area of effect. The spell lasts as long as the casting wizard remains at the centre of effect and meditates, during which time that wizard gains +x1 Meditation Rate, e.g. if he had standard meditation gains double meditation rate, if he had double it becomes triple meditation rate, et cetera. ~ 68 ~

name: Mass Shield
verbal: May the Gold Drake shield and protect all my allies!
description: Cause all marked allies within 20ft to benefit from a Shield (Other) spell. Each individual Shield spell may be dispelled as a 3 mana spell.

name: Mass Warding
verbal: May the Gold Drake ward and protect me from all my foes!
description: Acts as per the Warding spell but effects any one that is not a Marked Ally to the caster. While active, the caster is unable to move, or cast, but can speak.

name: Pacification
verbal: The Golden Drake wishes calm and peace here ... Pacification.
description: One target not immune to Emotion Attacks is caused to leave any form of 'rage' or berserk which they are currently in, and may not use any such ability for 5 minutes. If this is used on a Marked Ally the mana cost is reduced by 2.

name: Reviving Command
verbal: By the power of the Golden Drake I command thee arise!
description: Removes the effects of any ongoing cataleptic state, coma, unconsciousness or sleep, bar those caused by spiritual effects, damage, or the target's own abilities (e.g. not use of Resistance to Dying Effects). If the effect to be removed was a stackable rune or other level-based effect, then the caster's skill level (e.g. 9th level mana and casting) must be equal to or higher than the level of the effect. Cannot be used against other stopping effects like Paralysis or Freeze, but only those described above. May only be used on Marked Allies.

name: Acid Blast
verbal: By the power of water I strike thee... Acid Blast!
description: This spell delivers 12 points TBLP and 2 points per location of magical acid damage against which only magical armour class defends. This spell delivers 4 hits to monsters.

name: Clairaudiency
verbal: May the power of illusions twist that which passes between the real and unreal - and grant me the power of Clairaudiency.
description: This spell allows the caster to hear and speak through an illusion he has control of. Only one illusion may be empowered at a time in this manner. This spell will last for the duration of the illusion, to a maximum of 5 minutes.

name: Collection
verbal: Undines at my command bring forth that which is hidden I call that ..... to me.
description: This spell calls to the caster’s hand one object that is currently under the effects of a Vanish glyph that he has previously cast. Does not work on Vanish Animate types, only normal Vanish.

name: Drizzle's Water of Life
verbal: May the Dragon of Water - touch his favour upon this water of life.
description: This spell transforms 50ml (or more) of water such that it acts as a single dose of 6 TBLP healing potion, if drunk within the duration. Note that the water is magically enchanted, e.g. for the purposes of Monk magic use restrictions and priestly use of spiritual powers.

name: Purify Water
verbal: Purest water return and let impurities fade.
description: Up to 27' cubic feet of non-supernatural liquid is instantly converted to pure water. This does not affect animate beings of any sort.

name: Rain Shower
verbal: Undines at my command bring forth a shower of rain – bring water to this place.
description: This spell causes rain to fall from seemingly nowhere. This short, soft shower of rain has no in-game effects except that any location within range counts as an acceptable location for the purposes of Undine Elemental shift and Water Shift. There are no restrictions on where this spell may be cast, as the water is summoned directly from the Elemental Plane of Water. The water so summoned remains useable and effective for 5 minutes.

name: Talk to Fluid
verbal: Undines of water converse with me and tell me of your purpose!
description: As Talk To Inanimate but only works on fluids. Fluids have absolutely no perception beyond themselves and will generally be hedgy about what they are, requiring intensive discussion and persuasion. Fluids have excellent memories. A wizard may not speak to the fluid contained within an animate object by use of this spell.

name: Unseen Ally
verbal: Undines at my command, create for me a servant and ally to act unseen in my name.
description: As per Unseen Servant; however, may wield up to two weapons (which remain visible!) and inflict base damage with them. ~ 69 ~

name: Unseen Strength
verbal: Undines at my command, strengthen my servant with your power.
description: May be cast on an Unseen Servant or Unseen Ally (see below). The spell grants the target +1 Strength, and additional resilience, such that it now requires 15 hits to destroy. This allows an Unseen Ally to inflict +1 damage grade, as normal. It should be noted that Unseen Servants have a roughly humanoid form.

name: Water Cannon
verbal: Mighty waters repel thee! Water Cannon
description: One target is hurled back 40' by a powerful jet of water from the caster's hands, or until their travel is blocked by a solid object (cf. Repulsion). This is solely a physical effect, and Immunity to Knockbacks and Repels applies.

name: Acid Strike
verbal: By the mighty powers of the undine I dissolve thee... Acid Strike!
description: This spell delivers 24 points of TBLP and 4 points per location of magical damage against which only magical armour class applies. The spell also dissolves 2 points of physical armour class including toughened skin (which will regrow after the adventure only). Master crafted armour loses only one point of PAC per acid strike. This spell delivers 8 hits to monsters. Immunity to Acid stops the dissolving of the PAC and halves the damage suffered.

name: Dargan’s Water to Wine I
verbal: May the green take this liquid and transform it from …… into …..
description: Transforms one normal non-supernatural liquid into another liquid. Will create a single batch with Immediately available recipe that must be used within 60 seconds.

name: Dargan’s Water to Wine II
verbal: May the green take this liquid and transform it from …… into …..
description: Transforms one normal non-supernatural liquid into another liquid. Will create a single batch with Simple recipe that must be used within 60 seconds.

name: Dargan’s Water to Wine III
verbal: May the green take this liquid and transform it from …… into …..
description: Transforms one normal non-supernatural liquid into another liquid. Will create a single batch with Average recipe that must be used within 60 seconds.

name: Dargan’s Water to Wine IV
verbal: May the green take this liquid and transform it from …… into …..
description: Transforms one normal non-supernatural liquid into another liquid. Will create a single batch with Difficult recipe that must be used within 60 seconds.

name: Distortion
verbal: Water distort my features, twist and hide me from my foe such that I may avoid his every blow.
description: The spell grants the wizard immunity to the following attack modes or skills: Force Majeure / Damage Focus / Backstab / Accuracy / Call Location Shot / H & MP Class Weapons / Puissant D'Armes. ~ 70 ~

name: Douse
verbal: Let the might of the waters snuff the flames... Douse!
description: Will extinguish one normal fire up to the size of a large bonfire, or dispel one ongoing fire-based spell of up to 6 mana (e.g. Fireblade, Sword of Power, Salamander '6'). When used on more powerful fire-based creatures it inflicts 24 tblp (8 Hits) - for example, to fire elves or larger Salamanders, to which only Resistance to Dispels applies.

name: Glamour
verbal: Undines grant to that one thoughts and dreams of me to be his friend – bewitch his eyes with thy glamour.
description: This spell weaves an illusion in the target's mind that the caster is a trusted friend, as per the Befriend Spirit miracle, including the backlash for betraying the 'friend'. This spell effects only those who have a resistance level to green mana less than the caster's skill level.

name: Lugh’s Illusionary Armour
verbal: Undines of water create for me a phantasm of armour to protect my form.
description: This spell creates an illusionary suit of armour around the caster. The armour absorbs the first 12 hits of weapon blow damage suffered before any A/C and damage reductions. This spell can only absorb damage from blows with a physical or magical component, and once the 12 hits are taken the spell ends The caster may only have one spell active at a time.

name: Phantasmal Nemesis
verbal: Feel the terror of viewing your nemesis... Fear!
description: This induces fear as per the 4 spirit miracle Cause Fear in the target indicated. For the duration, they are stricken by an irrational belief that the caster is a terrifying creature from their nightmares. This will only work on creatures that can perceive fear and thus will not work on undead, elementals or the like.

name: Replicate
verbal: Undines at my command bring forth mystery, by the weavers’ arts let a …[object]… be made.
description: This spell creates an Illusion, albeit solid and real, of an object of the caste’rs choosing. This object may be as small as desired, but no bigger than 27 cubic feet. It may be as detailed and complex as the caster desires. Intricate designs such as maps, or scroll paperwork may be produced. More practical examples would include replicating weapons, doors and the similar. The replicated object is indestructible whilst formed, except by things that could destroy a magic object, such as Dispel ofShatter-style magical powers. Only things within view, or seen that adventure, may be replicated.

name: Shimmer
verbal: May the undines of water grant my image a hazy shimmer to confound my foes.
description: This grants dexterity armour class up to the maximum armour class of the wizard.

name: Acid Rain
verbal: Undines at my command bring forth a shower of rain to burn all around me with acid.
description: In a similar manner to Rain Shower [see page 70] this spell creates a short shower of acidic rain, which will burn the skin of all those within the radius. It causes 6/1 magical acid damage, against which MAC applies. Thus MAC 1 will stop its effects. Immunity to Acid grants 1/2 effect.

name: Acid Stream
verbal: By the mighty powers of the green dragon, may thee be dissolved utterly, may acid roil and blisters burn... Acid Stream!
description: This spell has the following effects on the target of the spell: 1. Target takes 36/6 magical acid damage against which only magical armour class applies. 2. All physical armour class on the target is destroyed. 3. All non magical/spiritual/"Item" objects are destroyed. To monsters this spell inflicts 12 Hits. Immunity to Acid stops parts 2 and 3 and halves the damage from 1.

name: Awe
verbal: Undines surround me and let none see the truth. Gift their eyes with visions of marvels...
description: The caster is surrounded by a glamour of vague but powerful magic. All creatures with a mind within sight of him will sense a feeling of majesty and power radiating from him, and will be unwilling and unable to initiate combat with him unless they have 10th Level Resistances to Magic or are Immune to Emotion Attacks. The spell is broken for any individual attacked by the caster, whether in melee or by direct spells. It is not effective when the caster cannot be seen.

name: Dessication
verbal: May the Green Dragon deny thee thy fluids, let thy body dry and fail... Dessication!
description: This spell delivers 24 points of TBLP damage and 4 points per location to a flesh and blood target and ignores magical armour class. The only exception to the flesh and blood rule are creatures who are made up of water and are not flesh and blood, who instead receive double the damage from the attack. Monsters suffer 8 hits from this spell, or 16 if they are an aquatic elf, an undine, et cetera...

name: Dissolve
verbal: Acid! Take a hold of that ...[object]...cause it to rust and fail...Dissolve
description: This spell will "rust" a non-spiritual inanimate metal object of up to 27 cubic feet at the end of its duration, completely and irrevocably destroying it. If the spell is dispelled before that time, the object is unharmed. Even "item" and trusty old objects can be destroyed in this way, as long as they are mostly made of metal, and do not contain a spirit.

name: Illusionary Concealment
verbal: Undines at my command hide me within your phantasms so that sight is tricked and eyes misled.
description: This spell means that the wizard cannot be perceived by normal physical sight. The spell ends if the wizard casts another spell, moves faster than a slow walk, makes an attack or uses any ability, or after 5 minutes, whichever is shorter. This is an illusion, and thus creatures unaffected by illusions, such as mindless creatures (e.g. zombies or animated statues), are able to see through it.

name: Mass Vanish
verbal: By all my powers and the will of the Green Dragon I command all before me to Vanish!
description: Causes all objects within the area to suffer the effects of the Vanish. Note the short duration of the spell. Also due to the nature of the spell it is not possible to use collection with it as the spell cannot distinguish between vanished objects. ~ 71 ~

name: Slippery Grip
verbal: May the power of the undines of water fill your hands...slime be upon you! Slippery Grip.
description: The target's hands are coated in a thick magical slime which means that no objects can be held in the hands, unless they be purely spiritual. This applies to weapons as well as other objects. Immunity to Supernatural Fumble Effects grants immunity to this spell.

name: Vanish Animate
verbal: By all my powers and my mastery of the undines I command thee to Vanish!
description: One animate target within range vanishes completely, in a way similar to the Standard spell Vanish. For the duration they are deemed not to exist for any purpose – durational effects upon them will resume from where they left off when they reappear, and the target will hardly be aware of their absence. Immunity to Involuntary Mystical Transportation effects grants immunity to this spell, and 1/2 effect magic or similar halves the duration. It should be noted that while Vanished objects effectively 'do not exist', thus items cannot be ‘called to hand’ from Vanish, etc.

name: Drown
verbal: Mighty undines let lungs fill with brine and let him/her choke and gasp beneath the weight of the waters... Drown!
description: One target who breathes has their lungs and body filled to overflowing with water, which wells from their mouth and nostrils. • The immediate effect of this is that the target is unable to speak or breathe. • After 30 seconds they are unable to use masteries, DAC, or any ability which requires concentration. • After 1 minute they are unable to stand, and from this moment on take 1 point of damage to each of chest and abdomen locations (2 tblp in total), or 1 Hit to monsters, every 10 seconds the spell lasts (making a total of 48 tblp and 24 to each of chest and abdomen (24 Hits) by the end of the spell's duration – four minutes of damage). This damage is normal physical damage based on the need to breathe - not magical damage. Targets are not freed to act if struck, and in fact the only ways to free the target from the spell are to somehow grant them the ability to breathe water, such as with a Walk through Water (Other) spell, or to dispel the glyph. Large Lung Capacity does not help, as all lung capacity is filled with water. If Determination or similar is possessed, it is possible to continue acting under the effects of the Drown, ignoring penalties bar damage (and the inability to speak, to which Immunity to Dumbness does not apply), but additionally taking Determination damage every 30 seconds! It is not possible to use abilities like War Cry. Resistance to Green Mana halves the duration of the spell as normal, thus dramatically reducing the damage taken overall.

name: Tempest’s Depths of the Ocean
verbal: Feel as the crushing depths of the ocean surround your form. Let the weight of the ancient seas and oceans be upon thee and bring you low.
description: Causes the targets chest to be crushed by water pressure. This acts as a Location to Zero to the chest. Resistances to Sever applies, and resistances to Green mana provide a stacking resistance to sever. Walk through water (or an Aquatic Elves unimpeded by water ability) means the target is unaffected. This spell only effects those with a physical presence.

name: Unseen Killer
verbal: Undines at my command I summon thee forth, I conjure thee to hunt down my foe!
description: Acts in a similar manner to Unseen Servant (including the number of hits). However it is summoned with O and E skill, and a pair of invisible daggers. It has 3 grades of backstab and will hunt down one chosen target, attacking only them.

name: Acquisition
verbal: May the elements be called into this ..[object]... for a while.
description: This spell may be cast upon any physical object under 27 cubic feet, and not containing a spirit. For its duration the object will not count against a magician’s metal allowance. It only works on singular objects like a Plate and a Sword. For suits of armour, each location will require a separate glyph.

name: Force
verbal: Dragons of Magic empower this glyph with your Force.
