description: This spell empowers the next damaging spell cast by the wizard to cause the target to either be Knocked Down [as trip no object required] or or to be hit by a Knockback [10']. Immunity to Trip or Immnity to Repels applies as appropriate.

name: Improved Detect Magic
verbal: I call upon the elements of fire, air, earth and water, reveal unto me where you may be found and relate thy potency!
description: As the Standard Detect Magic cantrip but it also reveals the mana point level and colour of the magic it detects.

name: Magical Glimpse (Cantrip)
verbal: I call upon the elements within that _______ to reveal yourself to me now - Glimpse Magic.
description: As the basic wizard ability Recognise Mana on a single specified target within range. This is not cumulative with any enhancements to Recognise Mana.

name: Twilight
verbal: May the elements throw light and dark in confusion.
description: Causes the area within 10ft of where the spell is cast to be filled with twilight. This negates any magical darkness or light as it is appears.

name: Twilight (R)
verbal: May the elements throw light and dark in confusion over there.
description: As Twilight (Self) but the caster may chose to focus it on themselves so that it moves with them (cf. Light Range).

name: Artefact Shield
verbal: May the power of my magic confound those that would seek to destroy my treasures.
description: Acts similarly to a passive Dispel Magic when cast on a magical (only) item, but only negating the first magical disenchanting effect (e.g. Negation) to target that item.

name: Disrupt Essence
verbal: By the power of the elements I strike thee... Disrupt Essence.
description: Inflicts 24/4 magical damage (8 Hits) to any creature harmed or destroyed by Dispels, regardless of all armour class. Half-effect Dispels halves the damage inflicted. It has no effect whatsoever on other targets.

name: Harmonic Enchantment
verbal: I entreat the elements of Fire, Air, Earth, Water, Light, Darkness and Twilight to place this _____ in perfect balance, may it remain true, whole and untouched.
description: This spell may be cast on any inanimate object of up to 27 cubic feet in volume, rendering it immune to non-spiritual Disintegrate, Shatter, Rust, Melt, Crystallise, Warp and Reshape effects while the spell remains active.

name: Mage Sight
verbal: Mighty dragons guide my sight.
description: Grants the caster the ability Mage Sight, as per the tables ability, allowing them to see the colour and mana levels of all magic around them. This sight is not impeded by physical objects (unless they are also magical). For example, if looking at a red wizard with a Plate (S) spell active on them, even if the wizard was the other side of a solid wall, the caster could see a red mana source of 10+ mana level, surrounded by a 3 mana grey mana source.

name: Mana Shield
verbal: Let the elements of fire, air, earth and water, light and darkness, turn away from me.
description: This spell grants the wizard total immunity to all forms of magic, including dispels to remove this glyph. Note: if cast by a magical creature such as an Elf, Drave or Faerie, the creature instantly dies (and if cast mantically by a creature which has a spirit that creature also instantly dies). Whilst this spell is running the wizard may not use spells or magical items or benefit from any source of magic. ~ 73 ~

name: Prismatic Blade
verbal: I call forth the magic of “A” into this blade. Let the twilight dragon bind its power.
description: Turns a single mundane weapon into a +0 magic weapon of the chosen colour for the duration.

name: Prismatic Ward
verbal: May the elements defend me from the powers of the [elemental name].
description: This spell acts similarly to the Protection From Spirits miracle, and must be drawn in chalk or with a stick when casting in the same manner as that miracle. When cast, a single basic colour of magic is chosen (not Grey or the "New Colours"), and no creature made of magic of that colour may cross the ward unless their resistance level to grey magic is greater than the caster's skill level, or unless they are immune to Protection From Spirits. Additionally, all spells and creatures of the specified colour that cross the ward are subject to a Dispel at the caster's skill level, often cancelling such spells before they reach their target.

name: Spleenripper's Magical Nexus
verbal: Dragons of Magic bare witness and focus your attentions on me for a while as I become the Nexus.
description: This spell grants the caster +1x med rate [not cumulative with any other temporary increase] - for as long as they do not cast any other spell. This spell is still restricted by the system limits on meditation.

name: Strength of the Magi
verbal: May the elements imbue my form with the strength of the Dragons.
description: This spell grants the wizard +1 strength, which will not stack with any other form of strength. It may also be cast on others for the same cost. However, it will only benefit them if they are magical creatures such as Elves, Draves or Faeries (creatures which would be harmed or destroyed by use of a Dispel).

name: Talk to Elementals
verbal: Mighty elementals / (A), speak to me and relate what thou knowest.
description: May either be used as a Talk to Element of choice, chosen when cast, or used to speak to all corporeal elementals in the area – that is all those that have taken physical form only, regardless of their type. Caster must choose which version when casting, as verbals indicate.

name: Damage Shield
verbal: I call upon the powers of the elements to shield me from the blows of my foes!
description: This spell reduces the damage done by any solely physical attack by 9pts before other defences are factored in. Against any attack with a magical component only 6pts are taken from the damage before other defensive factors are considered. Spiritual and Earthpower enhanced attacks ignore the defence of this spell. This spell does not stack with any spell which generates armour class, e.g. Plate (S), Shield (O), et cetera. This spell does not stack with itself and only stacks with natural armour class. It does not stack with any form of Distancing, Counter or Contra Mastery or other such numerical damage reductions.

name: Devastate the magic
verbal: By my might and the potency of magic I sunder the magic from you!
description: Causes all active spells on the target to suffer a dispel 6. This does not harm animate creatures.

name: Disenchant
verbal: May magic be banished from this …… for a while.
description: For the duration of this spell one piece of non-animate magic is considered ‘Negated’. It loses all magical properties; this would include lines, magical wardings and the similar, if they would be normally removed by a Dispel glyph.

name: Dispel XI
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements Dispel 11!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 15. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 11 and 15 (inclusive). Dispel 10 is a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XII
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements Dispel 12!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 15. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 11 and 15 (inclusive). Dispel 10 is a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XIII
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements Dispel 13!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 15. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 11 and 15 (inclusive). Dispel 10 is a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XIV
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements Dispel 14!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 15. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 11 and 15 (inclusive). Dispel 10 is a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XV
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements Dispel 15!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 15. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 11 and 15 (inclusive). Dispel 10 is a prerequisite.

name: Embody Elemental
verbal: ...(A)... of ...(B)... share my form and grant me thy power!
description: The wizard may embody an elemental 6 that they have just summoned, this grants the following powers and no others: The ability to shift at will as the appropriate elemental. The elemental sight possessed by the elemental. There are several disadvantages of embodying elementals as detailed below: • If the elemental is dispelled, destroyed or removed in any other fashion the caster dies. • If the Embody Elemental glyph is dispelled the Caster and Elemental die as the elemental materialises in the same space occupied by the caster. • If an elemental touches the wizard the wizard and the elemental vanish as they negate each other. The wizard's body will never be seen again.

name: Phase Barrier
verbal: May the lords of the elements deny passage to all.
description: Similar to Phase Trap (above), this glyph allows the caster to draw a line of up to 15' in length, or a 6' radius circle, which cannot be crossed in either direction by any shifting using magical means, instead appearing just outside the line on the route they were taking. Additionally, if an elemental of mana level 6 or lower touches the line, the elemental is dissipated as if touched by another elemental.

name: Phase Trap
verbal: I call upon the power of the elements to hold thee to this place... Phase Trap.
description: This prevents the target using magical means to "Shift" e.g. Airshift, Earthshift, Teleport, Mass Teleport, Blink, et cetera, for the spell's duration. It also has the side effect of destroying level 6 or lower elementals, as though they were touched by another elemental.

name: Summon Elemental 'Champion'
verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of ...(A)..., I entreat the elements of Fire, Air, Earth, Water, Light and Darkness. Come forth Champion of ...(A)... let a ...(B)... of ...(A)... appear to do my will.
description: This spell conjures an elemental '12' to be commanded. An elemental '12' may take 40 hits before being destroyed and inflicts 15pts of damage with its hands. It will not be negated by being struck by a 4 or 6 mana elemental, only by an 8 mana or higher elemental. All other details are as standard summon elemental such as sylph '6'. ~ 74 ~

name: Superplate
verbal: May the elements imbue my skin with the strength of Adamantium!
description: This spell grants the caster magic and physical armour class to his maximum armour class or 10, whichever is lower.

name: Transient Artificing
verbal: Into this ______ I call the elements of Fire, Air, Earth, Water, Light, Darkness and Twilight, may form and function be made perfect with my magic.
description: This spell enchants a normal physical weapon, shield or suit of armour such that it becomes +0 magical for the duration.

name: Dispel XVI
verbal: My might, the potency of magic, the power of the elements and the grace of the Dragons Dispel 16!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 20. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 16 and 20 (inclusive). Dispels 11–15 are a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XVII
verbal: My might, the potency of magic, the power of the elements and the grace of the Dragons Dispel 17!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 20. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 16 and 20 (inclusive). Dispels 11–15 are a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XVIII
verbal: My might, the potency of magic, the power of the elements and the grace of the Dragons Dispel 18!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 20. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 16 and 20 (inclusive). Dispels 11–15 are a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XIX
verbal: My might, the potency of magic, the power of the elements and the grace of the Dragons Dispel 19!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 20. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 16 and 20 (inclusive). Dispels 11–15 are a prerequisite.

name: Dispel XX
verbal: My might, the potency of magic, the power of the elements and the grace of the Dragons Dispel 20!
description: As Dispel Magic but works on mana of up to 20. It is only possible to buy these dispels in a package. This package costs 125pts and grants the ability to cast all of the dispels between 16 and 20 (inclusive). Dispels 11–15 are a prerequisite.

name: Negation
verbal: May magic be banished from that ...
description: This spell permanently removes the magical enchantment from any one magical object (this spell does not affect animate objects or objects which contain a non-magical supernatural component). E.g. A +3 Magical Bastard Sword which cast Lightning Bolt 6 times a day, +5 magical armour class and permanent See Through Magical Darkness can be destroyed. A +0 spiritual hand mace or a +0 magical / +0 spiritual sword would not be.

name: Zenith’s Magical Destruction
verbal: By my might, the potency of magic and the power of the elements I sunder the magic on thee and destroy its power!
description: The spell hangs for 10 seconds after casting and causes the target to suffer a Dispel 10 on all active spells on them.

name: Claw of the Drake
verbal: Ivory Drake transform this weapon such that it holds the power of your claw.
description: This spell augments a traditional wizard's weapon:- Staff, Spear or Dagger or, if cast by a Warlock, this can include a Bastard Sword, Axe or Mace. The weapon can only be used by the caster and they cannot be physically disarmed, although a Vanish will affect the weapon normally. The weapon inflicts magical damage and delivers an additional 6/1 damage on each blow (+2 hits to monsters), which ignores armour class in the same manner as a blast from a Supermissile. This enhancement cannot be stacked with any other form of enhancement, e.g. poison, Enhance Weapon, Fireblade or +0 magic, et cetera and is limited to a damage call of "Quad" as normal.

name: Conflict
verbal: Mighty Ivory Drake witness now as I call to you to aid me in this conflict. May…name… know your power and my honour.
description: This glyph grants the caster the effects of a Sanctuary spell but only against the nominated target. There are no restrictions on how far the caster may travel and benefit from this glyph.

name: Honour
verbal: Let the Drake watch as I act with honour.
description: The caster becomes Immune to Backstab and gains 1/2 effect damage from behind, unless that damage is neither physical nor magical. During this time should he strike any target in the back, or the referee deem that he deliberately turned to take a blow on the back rather than the front, the spell is cancelled and the caster is deemed to have broken the Ivory code.

name: Lesser Enhance Weapon
verbal: May the Ivory Drake twist this weapon and its blow strike true.
description: As per the spell Enhance Weapon but does not grant any additional damage grades.

name: Replenish
verbal: May the drake replenish my strength!
description: Restores 6/2 temporary life from an Ivory spell the caster is currently benefiting from. This will not heal real damage, but replenishes only temporary life. If some locations have not been injured these will be unaffected by the spell, and in no way will this spell take life above the maximums allowed by any other spells the caster has upon them, nor heal damage to the caster themselves, rather than the temporary life.

name: See through Mists (Other)
verbal: Mighty drake let the mist part before this ally's eyes!
description: One Marked Ally may see through the Ebony spell Mists for the duration. This spell may be cast on self at a base cost of 3 mana.

name: Yossarian's Might of the Drake
verbal: Mighty Drake of Ivory, let this your weapon cut deep into the enemy.
description: Once cast, enhances an Enhance Weapon spell wielded by the caster to inflict +4 base damage from +3, and grants it a maximum damage (unenhanceable in any way) of Quin. In this case the weapon must be the only weapon used by the caster, otherwise no benefits are gained.

name: Armour of Alator
verbal: Ivory drake protect my body, turn aside the blades of my foes and cover me in the Armour of Alator
description: Grants the caster half effect sharp weapon blows for the duration.

name: Death in Battle
verbal: Into my body I call forth the power of the Ivory Drake, let my form survive beyond its mortal wounds.
description: Grants the caster live to minus infinite TBLP, and they may remain conscious while in all live to minus. Should they enter this additional live to (even if cured before the spell ends) then they die when the spell expires. Additionally, the caster’s locations continue to function regardless of their wounds, unless severed.

name: Empower Sanctuary
verbal: The Ivory Drake watches over this place - may my allies grow in strength, honour and courage in this Sanctuary!
description: This spell empowers a previously cast Sanctuary spell such that the benefits to the caster’s Mark Allies are increased to the following extent: • 25% Damage Reduction versus on-purely spiritual damage increases to 33.3% • 9th Level resistance to magic becomes ‘+1 level of resistance to magic’. • Chosen of the Dragon +2 DAC becomes ‘all allies gain +2 DAC’

name: Fury
verbal: May the Ivory Drake grant me the power to take her conflict to her foes.
description: As the Sanctuary spell however only the casting wizard is affected and there is no limit to the distance that he may move and still receive the benefits of the spell. This may be enhanced with spells that empower a sanctuary.

name: Hostile Sanctuary
verbal: The Ivory Drake offers battle to all those that seek conflict and resolution. We go forth to take the battle to the Enemy.
description: As per Sanctuary but the spell moves with the caster, maintaining a 30' radius around them at all times. Please note the greatly reduced duration. This may be empowered via Sanctuary-enhancing spells. ~ 76 ~

name: Ivory Armour
verbal: To this mortal conflict I should go, and may my magics defend me from Maces, staves and bows. In this world of trouble and strife protect me from haft and knife. Axes, Spears and Swords too defend me so they won’t cut true. May the Drake protect my form - her Ivory armour I adorn
description: The caster takes only 1pt per damage grade [cf. Rockskin] called from any weapon blow with a physical component; note that this includes Earth Power enhanced attacks, etc. However, any attack which cuts through Physical Armour class, such as Accuracy, avoids the defence this spell offers, unless the caster also has defensive abilities like Fortitude, which would stop the blow.

name: Ivory Strength
verbal: May the Ivory drake grant me stamina in the face of adversity!
description: The caster gains +24/8 temporary life (in the manner of Ivory Warrior) and +6 PAC. The life gained does not stack with any other temporary lifeincreases, except those granted by other Ivory spells (not this one).

name: Oath
verbal: Ivory Drake witness these oaths and let them bind these two closely.
description: Binds two characters to a willingly sworn Oath. Each character must recite their Oath audibly and in full, and then must clasp hands whilst this spell is cast. The caster may either be one of the participants or hold the clasped hands of the participants whilst casting this spell. If either participant is unwilling, this spell fails and the caster is made aware of which of the participants is unwilling. The oaths may be anything, and one may be trivial, but a pair of oaths must always be sworn. The oaths bind for one year unless initially sworn otherwise, or they can be released by the agreement of all parties including the caster. The oaths bind to the 'spirit' not the 'letter' of the oath, and at any time it is at the Ivory Drake's (ref's) discretion as to whether it has been held to. The oaths bind closely and the retribution for breaking one is terrible. An oath-breaker suffers the following disbenefits:• They fall unconscious for 5 minutes, plus 1 minute for each extra mana point placed into the Oath when it was cast. No resistance applies to this unconsciousness. • They suffer the loss of 6 TBLP, plus 1 TBLP for each extra mana point placed in the Oath when it was cast. This is accompanied by a loss of 1/3 of that amount to each location (rounding up), and is unresistable and permanent. This is a loss of base life, not damage. • They suffer the loss of 1 point of maximum AC, plus 1 point for every 3 extra mana points in the Oath. • The caster and other participant are made supernaturally aware of the oathbreaking, and the other participant's Oath is released. Note that when this spell is cast and extra mana is placed into it, the casting damage is also increased. The effects of this spell must be written on all affected characters' cards. The effects are not released if the other party dies, unless that was part of the original conditions. The Oath may be dispelled from either of those who swore at the total mana level of the spell, in which case the caster and other recipient are made supernaturally aware of this and the other participant's Oath is released.

name: Illyriel’s Protection
verbal: May Jade power strengthen your blood and ward it from harm.
description: Grants the recipient immunity to all forms of blood drain, or other attacks on the blood.

name: Life Overwhelms
verbal: Life
description: This spell must be cast within 2 seconds (CF War Cry or Deny Power) of suffering a non-spiritual effect that kills the caster. This grants the caster complete immunity to that effect. It cannot be applied to damage, and if the initial effect has a secondary effect, then this is still suffered. This spell costs the caster a casting level for 1 hour when used.

name: The Body Attunes
verbal: May your body shift and change and attune to XXXX.
description: Grants the recipient 50% off one chosen colour of magic for the duration. It cannot protect against Onyx magic, and an individual may only be warded against one colour at a time.

name: The Body Renews
verbal: May verdant power allow your body to heal.
description: Causes the target to begin to slowly heal, allowing them to regenerate 1TBLP and 1 to the most injured location every 5 minutes. This does not stack with other regeneration, and cannot heal damage suffered from purely spiritual attacks, or Onyx mana.

name: The Flow of Life
verbal: Let the vibrance of life flow between thee.
description: The spell forms a link between the two recipients, allowing injuries to be transferred between them. This functions in a similar manner to Empathic Healing, allowing wounds to be transferred from one target to the other. For each point of damage healed, 2 points is suffered. A maximum of 1 point of damage may be healed each second, meaning a maximum of 60 life can be healed over the spell’s duration. TBLP and locational damage may be healed at the same time.

name: The Life Within
verbal: Let your body be purified. May your heart beat strong, your lungs draw breath, and blood flow free
description: The recipient’s body is cleansed and refreshed. This grants them the benefits of a Herbal Infusion potion (as per the scout book) which grants +6/2 life and a level of resistance.

name: Verdant Form
verbal: May verdant power flow through your body and grant you great strength.
description: Acts as per Empower Form, except it grants the recipient 36/12 temp life. Onyx Magic

name: Ward the Body
verbal: May the Jade Dragon strengthen your body against the greatest of blows.
description: Grants the recipient a stacking resistance to sever/location to zero for the duration.

name: Rapid Degeneration
verbal: Let your body weaken and fade. Let wounds fester and bones become frail
description: Causes the target to begin to rapidly degenerate. This causes them to suffer 3/1 per location per 15 seconds for the duration. A target can only be suffering from one casting of this spell at a time. Resistance to Degeneration apply.

name: Weight of the Years
verbal: Feel the weight of the years upon thee as your body suffers.
description: The spell causes the target to age briefly, before returning to their normal state. The resulting shock to the system causes them to suffer 12/2 (4 hits) damage, to which MAC does not apply. Immunity to Ageing Effects applies. ~ 77 ~

name: Bone Break
verbal: With the power of the Onyx dragon I bid thy bones weaken and snap under my touch!
description: Causes the bones in next limb (arm or leg, normally) touched to snap and break. This causes it to become unusable until it has a regeneration miracle (or similar effect) cast upon it. The spell also causes 24/24 damage to the limb. Immunity to Involuntary Shape Shifting applies, and a Resistance to Sever/Loc to Zero grants immunity to the bone break effect, although the damage is still suffered.

name: Empathic Harm
verbal: With the Strength of the Onyx Dragon I claim the life that sustains your body.
description: When cast on a helpless (or willing) target the caster can drain their life to heal themselves. For every 3 life drained from the target them may heal themselves 1 point of damage. It takes 1 second to drain 3 life (1 Hit), although TBLP and Loc may be drained at the same time. Resistances to Empathic Harm double the time taken to drain the life.

name: Expose the Weakness
verbal: With Onyx power I change your form, let your weakness to X be exposed for all to see.
description: Causes the target to suffer 50% extra damage from one chosen colour of magic, otherwise functioning as per Weaken the Body (which it does not stack with). Immunity to Involuntary Shape Shifting applies.

name: Illyriel’s Weakness of the Blood
verbal: May your blood be weakened and your body suffer under my touch!
description: Causes the target to lose a level of resistance to magic. This is a flesh and blood effect. Immunity to level drain applies.

name: The Limbs Fail
verbal: The Onyx dragon holds your body in its grasp, and demands bones crumble and flesh wither.
description: Causes the target to suffer a Wither to all of their limbs.

name: The Shattered Form
verbal: With the power of the Onyx Dragon I bid they body snap and break. Let thy form suffer at my touch as I break bone, sunder flesh, and destroy the essence that binds you to life!
description: Once cast the spell hangs for 10 seconds. The target touched suddenly finds their chest begins to crumple and break. This acts as per a sever to the chest, which obviously kills the target if they do not have any resistances. If resistances to sever are owned then damage is suffered based on the target’s current life, not their maximum (EG if they had 30 life to the chest, were down 15, and had one resistance to sever then they would suffer 15 points of damage as their chest is reduced to zero). Red Magic

name: Burn Wood
verbal: By the powers of fire I burn that wooden ... away.
description: One normal, non-supernatural wooden object of up to 27 cubic feet catches fire and burns away, becoming unusable and leaving nothing but charred wood and ash. It may not be reformed.

name: Fire Dart
verbal: The powers of fire burn thee... Fire Dart,
description: Inflicts 6/1 magical fire damage in the same manner as the Fire Blast spell. Causes 2 hits to monsters.

name: Shield of Power
verbal: Onto my arm I call forth flame; Boss, Grip and Rim, shield of power, I conjure thee to guard my flank!
description: The created shield counts as a normal shield with magic properties. It grants non-stackable MAC 3 (with limitations akin to the Plate (S) spell) against ranged attacks, and permits a Sword of Power to be wielded one handed, doing 6pts less damage (Bastard Double to Monsters). ~ 78 ~

name: Waxing Flames
verbal: Let those flames burn bright and merrily... Waxing Flames!
description: One candle, lantern or other source of fire within range suddenly expands greatly, burning one target of the caster's choice within 3' of it with 18/3 magical fire damage (6 Hits to monsters). The flames quickly subside to normal levels afterwards.

name: Benevolent Warmth
verbal: Salamanders gather and share your heat.
description: The recipient gains immunity to natural cold and 1/2 effect magical cold, as well as an additional +2 resistance levels against non-spiritual Freeze effects, surrounding them with a constant comfortable warmth. Should this glyph be cast on an ice-based creature such as a winter elf, they suffer the loss of 2 DAC for the duration, and take 6/1 magical fire damage (2 Hits) every minute the glyph is active, to which MAC does not apply.

name: Circle of Flames
verbal: I call upon the salamanders of fire to build for me a circle of flame to surround my foe/me
description: This creates a circular wall of fire with a 10' radius which surrounds the point indicated by the caster. The wall is immobile and is as high as the ceiling or 40' on an overland adventure. Crossing the circle inflicts 18/3 points of magical fire damage (6 Hits) in the same manner as crossing a Wall of Fire.

name: Enhanced Wall of Fire
verbal: Salamanders of fire build for me a great wall of intense fire.
description: This creates a wall of fire that delivers 24/4 points of magical fire damage (8 Hits) to all who pass through it. An enhanced wall of fire cannot be created within 2 paces of another wall of fire or enhanced wall of fire due to the disrupting effects the two will have on each other. If they are created too close both are negated. Otherwise all details are as for wall of fire.

name: Ferowwl's Lesser Ashes
verbal: Mighty flames sweep forth and consume that wooden ...
description: One non-supernatural wooden object bursts into magical flames, which cannot be extinguished except by complete submersion in water. If the object is less than 27' cubic feet it is completely consumed in 2 seconds, otherwise it is destroyed at the rate of 27' cubic feet every 2 seconds until nothing is left but ashes. The flames from this spell may ignite other combustibles touching the target object, but any such other fires started are non-magical and burn or go out as normal.

name: Fire Trap
verbal: Here I leave fire to greet those who are not welcome.
description: The next person to pass through the portal upon which this has been placed receives a Fire Blast. Alternatively the Fire Trap may be placed upon an opening or closing object and is activated the next time someone opens or closes the object, even if it is the caster. Only one Fire Trap or Greater Fire Trap (see below) may be set on any one portal or object at any one time. The spell will automatically fade at the end of the adventure in which it was cast. Once the Fire Trap has been set the object may not be moved by any means without the trap going off. If cast by a Red Wizard with Fire Blast Expertise it costs only 4 mana to cast.

name: Fire Trick
verbal: Mighty Dragon of Fire grant fury to these flames that the [Nth] to cross thy threshold shall truly know thy hospitality.
description: This spell must be cast on an active Wall of Fire, and causes the wall to implode with great force into the Nth person to actively cross through the wall, as specified when casting (e.g. the first, second, third or even tenth person could be specified). Any actually within the Wall of Fire as this spell is cast are not counted. The implosion destroys the Wall of Fire but inflicts 36/6 magical fire damage to the unfortunate target, plus a magical Halt, which takes effect at the caster's skill level.

name: Fireshower
verbal: By the lesser powers of Fire and Brimstone, let all around be scorched.... Fireshower!
description: A shower of fire explodes outwards from the caster, inflicting 6/1 magical fire dart (2 Hits) to all within the radius. The caster also takes 6/1 magical fire damage, to which they may not apply MAC.

name: Great Shock
verbal: Into my hand I call forth the power of fire and brimstone...Great Shock
description: As the Standard spell Shock in all ways, except that the damage inflicted is 24/24 (8 Hits to monsters).

name: Lesser Fireball
verbal: Into my hand I call forth the purest power of fire to blast and destroy my foes!
description: This spell generates a tennis-ball sized globe of magical flame. 5 seconds after creation, or whenever thrown against a solid surface, the fireball explodes, inflicting 12/2 magical fire damage to all within 20' (4 hits to monsters) and igniting all flammable objects within the area (i.e. this is a magical Incendiary Cache).

name: Thanaur's Sabre of Fire
verbal: Into my hands I call forth fire - blade, hilt and guard. Sabre of fire I conjure thee for all to burn their enemies.
description: Summons a sword in all ways identical to a Sword of Power, except that it may be used by anyone who can use magical items. ~ 79 ~

name: Anar-Kadan's Firestorm
verbal: By the powers of fire and brimstone, let all around be burnt and charred... Firestorm!
description: A mass of fire explodes outwards from the caster, inflicting 24/4 magical fire damage (8 Hits) to all within the radius and hurling them back 6 paces unless they are Immune to Repels. The caster also takes 24/4 magical fire damage, to which he may not apply MAC.

name: Chains of Fire
verbal: By the powers of fire and brimstone, let all my enemies be burnt as I gather now the Chains of Fire.
description: This spell allows the caster to 'cast' the Fire Blast spell for 0 mana for the duration. The full verbal must be used and the caster takes 1TBLP per casting, which is unreducable and unavoidable by any means. The casting of this spell causes the caster to lose one casting level for the next hour.

name: Ferowwl's Greater Ashes
verbal: The fires of destruction char this ... to ash.
description: One wooden or cloth object of less than 27' cubic feet is burnt immediately to ash, even if magical. This does not affect objects with other supernatural power (e.g. spiritual or 'mantic objects). An object so destroyed cannot be mended.

name: Fire Strike
verbal: By all the greatest powers of fire, be thou scorched, be charred, be burnt and incinerated... Fire Strike!
description: This spell functions as per Disruption but inflicts 48/8 magical fire damage (16 Hits to monster).

name: Form Aflame
verbal: Salamanders of fire twist and transform my body to grant fortitude and heat.
description: This spell grants the caster physical armour class and maximum armour class 12. Also, the wizard may strike with hands and inflict 9 points of magical damage in a similar manner to a Sword of Power (i.e. only dexterity and magical armour class applies, damage is purely magical and flaming) at will for the duration. Full blows are required for these unarmed attacks as normal for unarmed combat, and the damage may not be 'stacked' with normal Unarmed Combat skill. However, if this is possessed the caster's blows may be chosen to be either as above or physical / magical and flaming, inflicting damage at the normal unarmed grade called by the caster.

name: Greater Fire Trap
verbal: Here I leave great fire to greet those who are not welcome.
description: This functions in all fashion exactly as the Fire Trap spell above, except when triggered it releases a Disruption. If cast by a Red Wizard with Disruption Expertise it costs only 9 mana to cast.

name: Implosion
verbal: By the great powers of the fiery dragon be thou cast down... Implosion
description: This spell causes a great build-up of heat within the target's internal organs and causes 9 points of damage to the target's head, chest and abdomen, 3 points to each limb and a total of 36pts of TBLP damage (12 Hits to monsters). This damage ignores all magical armour class, e.g. such as that offered by the Plate (S) spell.

name: Shower of Flame
verbal: May the fires gather and strike thee down in a Shower of Flames" ...X Fire Darts
description: This spell causes the target to be struck simultaneously by a number of Fire Dart spells [see above]. The number released equals the Wizard’s skill level. MAC and other defences may be applies versus each Fire Dart separately, thus MAC 1 would make you immune to this spell. This spell does however count as one spell for passive dispels and abilities such as Deny Power.

name: Vincenzo's Lesser Incineration
verbal: Salamanders of fire I command thee to consume my foe’s eyes with absolute heat!
description: One target within the short range has their eyes burnt out, as per the Incineration spell listed above., with Immunity to Fire (1/2 effect magical fire) granting complete immunity to this spell. This spell causes no damage.

name: Warmth of the Fire
verbal: Great Salamanders of Fire I call to you. Come to this place grant us your warmth, protect us from the fire and brimstone, warm us against Winter’s cold. I offer the Warmth of the Fire to my companions.
description: This spell may only be cast upon a fire of significant size, a bonfire, a tavern fireplace, a burning forge or similar. After spending 5 minutes within 20’ of the fire all participants gain +1MAC against Fire and Cold attacks. After 15 minutes they gain +1 level of resistance against Fire and Cold. After 60 minutes the previous benefits are doubled. Participants are free to leave the area of the fire, at any time taking with them the level of benefits they had accrued. The benefits of this last 1 hour per wizardly skill level of the caster. Those with ½ effect fire or similar reductions take twice as long to gain the benefits.

name: Chains of Fire Bolt
verbal: By all the powers of fire I call forth the chains of the greatest brimstone.
description: This spell acts as per the Chains of Fire spell except it allows the casting of the Fire Bolt spell at will for 2 TBLP (unreducible) per casting. Use of this spell costs the caster two casting levels for the next hour.

name: Flaming Destruction
verbal: By all the powers of fire be thou scorched, be charred, be burnt, and be incinerated as the fires consume you… Flaming Destruction!
description: Acts in a similar manner to Disruption, however, it causes the target to suffer 120/20 (40 HTK) and a magical halt at the caster’s skill level.

name: Incineration
verbal: Salamanders of fire I command thee to consume my foe with absolute heat, let flesh burn and bone melt.
description: This spell has several effects as the target is consumed in intense heat: 1. All normal metal on the target melts, 2. All potions boil dry, 3. Target suffers 36/6 magical fire damage (12 Hits), 4. All objects within 1' are ignited, 5. The target is blinded until a regeneration is cast upon their eyes (only one regeneration is required, which though it would not normally heal such damage does in this case).

name: Internal Combustion
verbal: Mighty salamanders I command thee to consume my foe from the inside out - let all be charred and burnt til only ash remains ... Internal Combustion!
description: One target touched with both hands is consumed with flames from within. The effects of this are: • If the target has 7th Level Resistance or below to magic they are instantly killed by the shock to their system. • If they have 8th Level Resistance they are stricken by the incredible pain of the searing fire such that they may not fight, cast, speak or stand for 1 minute. • If they have 9th Level Resistance or greater or Immunity to Fire (1/2 effect magical fire) they may not cast, run or speak and may only parry for 30 seconds. • If they have both 9th Level Resistance or greater and Immunity to Fire (1/2 effect magical fire) the duration for which they may not act is halved to 15 seconds. The target also suffers great injury from the fires, taking 48 TBLP, 12 points each to the head, chest and abdomen and 6 points to each limb (16 hits to monsters), to which no armour class (including MAC) may be applied (cf. Implosion).

name: The Dragon’s Breath
verbal: Feel the breath of the Dragon of Fire upon thee as your flesh burns and sears… Dragon’s Breath!
description: The spell causes all within the cone to suffer the effects of a Lesser Incineration spell.

name: Hereya’s Insight
verbal: Silver dragon answer me this …..
description: Allows the caster to gain a single word answer to one question.

name: Password
verbal: Silver Dragon, grant me the knowledge needed here.
description: This spell grants the caster knowledge of any password, pass-phrase, or required action which would be necessary to pass by an indicated obstacle within 3'. This may be human guards who require a password, or a magical barrier such as a Gold Forcewall spell, or similar. If the required activity to pass by the obstacle is more than three separate steps, (e.g. "Press the button, then step on stone 4, then on stone 7, then say 'Kazooma', then spill your own blood"), the caster will only gain the requisite information if they expend a further three mana, a choice they can make upon casting the spell, when they will know that extra mana is required.

name: Tell Profession
verbal: The Silver Dragon desires knowledge of thy profession.
description: This tells the wizard the profession (character class) of the target of this spell unless: It is a Priest class, Paladin or Unholy Champion. In each of these three cases, the response will be ‘Unknown’. Similarly, the profession of non-published races are also detailed as ‘Unknown’.

name: Visionary Gaze
verbal: May the Silver Dragon grant me visions of Knowledge.
description: Allows the caster to gain a vision as the answer to the next magical informational power used. The vision should be appropriate to the length of answer normally given.

name: Ariel's Lucky Idea
verbal: Silver Dragon bestow thy favour upon this/that one.
description: This spell grants the target a 'lucky idea' about something they wish to know (or another matter should the referee/Silver Dragon deem it more relevant).

name: Contra Mastery
verbal: Silver Dragon I implore thee, grant me knowledge of that weapon to better defend myself.
description: This grants the caster defensive knowledge such that they gain the benefit of the Tables Warrior ability of Contra Mastery. As per standard Contra Mastery this spell is rendered useless by abilities such as Unique Fighting Style, et cetera.

name: Counter Mastery
verbal: Silver Dragon I implore thee grant me defensive knowledge of this weapon.
description: This grants the caster defensive knowledge such that they gain the benefit of the Tables Warrior ability of Counter Mastery. As per standard Counter Mastery this spell is rendered useless by abilities such as Unique Fighting Style, et cetera.

name: Investigation
verbal: Silver Dragon! I seek insight and wisdom here, reveal to me the hidden knowledge bound to this magic.
description: This spell reveals to the caster all the information about a particular source of magic, its name, duration and effect. Additionally the wizard has up to 5 minutes to further quiz the magic about its nature, removal and purpose. This would include any side effects and disadvantages associated to the magic. E.g. The spell is cast on a Magic Sword. The spell instantly reveals it is a permanently bound grey enchanted weapon. Further quizzing will reveal that it is currently unpersonalised and that the words "Al'Rath Some" will bind it to an individual. More quizzing will reveal that once bound the weapon may never be taken from your hand and that you can never leave it behind, or remove it from your possession. Any item without a spirit will answer truthfully. An object with a spirit will answer as it pleases. ~ 83 ~

name: Lesser Communication
verbal: Silver Dragon hear my call! I pose this question for the knowledge of all…
description: This spell allows the caster to ask the Silver Dragon a single question, to which the answer may be anything up to a short sentence in length.

name: Master Weapon
verbal: Silver Dragon grant me the knowledge to wield this...
description: This grants the caster one additional mastery in a weapon in which they are already proficient (have the ability to use). This spell is non-cumulative with itself. The casting cost above is increased by the number of masteries already possessed in the named weapon. The glyph is bought at the cost of a 4 mana spell.

name: Mirror Learning
verbal: Silver Dragon desires knowledge of that spell…
description: After seeing a basic spell being successfully cast the Silver Wizard may learn from the magics. As long as the original caster is not immune to informational spells the Silver wizard may add the spell to his castable list till the next dawn. It is not necessary for the caster to have a ‘specialist slot’ for this glyph, though it may not be one of an opposite colour should one be possessed.

name: Proficiency
verbal: Silver Dragon guide my weak hands as they grasp this weapon.
description: This spell enables the wizard to use any one type of weapon (e.g. Bastard Sword) at the proficiency of a warrior without any special skills (e.g. Weapon Mastery).

name: Silver Tongue of Daysaris
verbal: The Silver Dragon grants me knowledge of your words.
description: The caster gains the ability to speak fluently in any one language being spoken to him at the time of casting. Once this spell expires, the knowledge is almost immediately lost as the caster's brain cannot handle the influx of so much information. Silver wizards may purchase the ability Good Memory for Languages for 25 points on Table 1. This ability will allow them to retain enough language knowledge from a casting of this spell to remember how to speak and understand a slow broken form of that language for the rest of the adventure. Immunity to Informational Spells on the part of the foreign-language speaker prevents the spell from functioning.

name: Solstice’s Mark of Fate
verbal: May the Silver Dragon grant me insight into your intentions!
description: Grants the caster insight into the intentions of the target within combat. This acts as per a Force Majeure DAC 6 vs the chosen target. It does not reduce the caster’s DAC.

name: Commune With The Silver Drake
verbal: Great Silver Dragon whose power is mighty give me the answer to these three questions I now ask!
description: The effects of this spell are the same as the Standard miracle Communication II, except answers about spiritual objects may not be answered (but may be answered about magical ones). White Magic

name: Foretold
verbal: It was Foretold
description: This spell may be cast after the target is personally targeted by a magic spell. It must be cast straight afterwards in the style of a War Cry [within 2 seconds]. It grants complete immunity to the spell as if the caster had a Know Foe active against the user. As such, this spell fails should the conjurer of the spell to be "Foretold" be immune to informational spells. The casting of this spell causes the loss of a casting level for the next hour.

name: Allied Light
verbal: Sprites of Light I conjure thee - stay with that one for a while to light his way...Allied Light.
description: This spell centres a Light [Range] spell upon the target - who need not be willing. A Darkness spell will negate it and vice-versa. If the target is willing and the spell is cast at touch range then this spell costs a base of 5 mana.

name: Chill Wind
verbal: Cold wind blow, winds of winter show - and chill all those before me...Chill Wind.
description: This spell conjures a very cold wind, causing all those within its cone of effect. [60 degrees 20'] to suffer the loss of 2 DAC, unless Immunity to Cold or Immunity to Dexterity Drain is possessed. This spell inflicts 4 hits to monsters statted without AC. The DAC loss lasts 5 minutes.

name: Crystallise (Range)
verbal: Mighty cold freeze and crystallise that...
description: Should the item be struck or used to strike a physical blow at any point during the duration of the spell it shatters as per the 2 mana Standard Blue glyph Shatter. Non-supernatural items only.

name: Crystallise (Touch)
verbal: Mighty cold freeze and crystallise this...
description: Should the item be struck or used to strike a physical blow at any point during the duration of the spell it shatters as per the 2 mana Standard Blue glyph Shatter. This will only function on Non-supernatural items only and to a maximum of 27 cubic feet.

name: Javelin of Ice
verbal: Into my hands I call forth ice... Javelin of ice!
description: Replicates the Winter elf innate ability listed in the handbook, inflicting 24/4 magical cold damage to one target. MAC applies, stopping 6/1 per point.

name: Light Step
verbal: Let me move as light - Light step!
description: Allows the caster to take 7 paces in Time Freeze, as he moves too fast for any to act. Those with Lightning Reactions may keep their eyes open and follow his progress. During this time the wizard may take no other actions than take steps.

name: Slip
verbal: By the might of Ice... Slip
description: Target is affected as if by a Trip spell, but need not be moving nor have obstacles in their way.

name: Super Snowball
verbal: I call the might of ice and frost into my hand... Super Snowball
description: In all ways as the brown spell Supermissile, except that no stone is needed as the snowball is created in the caster's hand, and the damage is cold-based, inflicting x2 damage to fire-based creatures.

name: The Brilliant Glare
verbal: May the brilliant light blind your eyes.
description: Causes the target to be struck with intense light and blinded for the duration. Immunity to Blindness applies, and the spell will not function in a magical darkness or a twilight.

name: Bedazzle
verbal: Mighty Sprites confuse my enemies eyes and project forth a bedazzling guise!
description: The caster becomes covered by bright sparkling lights which make subterfuge impossible. The effect of this light however is that an attack against the wizard suffers the following penalties: 1: The assailant loses all weapon masteries (including backstabs) 2: The wizard gains 2 points of magical armour class (MAC) which will not stack with MAC from other spells. This spell will not operate in magical darkness nor against a blind opponent, but it will work against an opponent who has his eyes closed.

name: Dazzling Lights
verbal: Sprites of Light I conjure thee, dance, weave and sparkle bright - take this one's skills away with light.
description: This spell causes the target to lose the use of all weapon masteries (and backstabs) for the duration as bright dazzling lights flash in the caster’s eyes. Immunity to Loss of Weapon Masteries due to Visual Impairments, Enhanced Perception, etc, apply.

name: Frost Blade
verbal: Let the might of ice coat this blade and chill my foe... Frost Blade.
description: Coats one normal, non-supernatural edged weapon with frost, so that in the hands of the caster only each blow inflicts damage equivalent to the Snowball spell, rather than it's normal damage.

name: Glacier Field
verbal: Mighty powers of cold freeze the ground, as though winter has come...Glacier Field
description: As per Sheet of Ice, above, except that the sheet causes any person within the radius of the spellto Slip each time they try to take a step. The Glacier Field may be destroyed by 400 hits, or 100 fire-based hits. ~ 85 ~

name: Invisibility
verbal: May sprites bend thy light so that I may hide from sight!
description: This spell means that the wizard cannot be perceived by normal physical sight. The spell ends if the wizard casts another spell, moves faster than a slow walk, makes an attack or uses any ability, or after 5 minutes, whichever is shorter.

name: Plasma Blade
verbal: I call upon the powers of the mightiest light to enhance this blade with the brightest light!
description: This enhances a normal bladed weapon by +2 damage grades if wielded by the wizard, or +1 if wielded by another person. The weapon now inflicts magical, light-based damage.

name: Plasma Streak
verbal: By the greater powers of light, I do smite thee... Plasma Streak.
description: As the Standard spell Plasma Bolt but with the above modifications (increased range).

name: Roger's Boots of Ice
verbal: By the might of Ice I bid thee slip for a while, Boots of Ice!
description: The target's feet are surrounded in slippery ice for the duration, such that whenever in contact with a solid surface they are affected as if by a Slip, as above. The application of any magical fire of 2 mana or above to the feet will remove the ice (e.g. holding a Fireblade near, a Fire Blast or Shock spell, or similar).

name: Sabre of Light and Truth (other)
verbal: Into my hands I call forth the purest light, blade, hilt, and guard I conjure thee, may all who wield you smite at the Darkness.
description: This spell conjures a Sabre of Light of Truth, but one that may be used by any goodly person, not just the caster.

name: Sheet of Ice
verbal: Mighty powers of cold freeze the ground around me! Sheet of Ice
description: All creatures within 20', excluding the caster, are affected by a Slip spell, as above.

name: Blade Rune – Stasis
verbal: By my arts and sorcery I inscribe the rune of Stasis upon this blade - let any struck feel the clench and pause of my magics.
description: This spell is may be cast on any bladed weapon, with the caster inscribing a magical rune on the weapon (if even with his finger) as the spell is cast. The next blow struck with that weapon by the caster inflicts a stunning effect as per a magical Stasis, effecting those with a resistance level to grey mana less than the caster's skill level. Multiple Stasis runes may be drawn on the weapon, triggering with each successive blow, although a dagger-sized weapon can hold only a single rune, a broadsword-sized weapon at most 2 runes, a bastard sword-sized weapon 3 runes and a greatsword-sized weapon 5 runes. If learnt with points this spell comes with 5 runes. This spell cancels any other Blade Rune spell active on the target weapon when cast.

name: Pact with the … Drake / Dragon
verbal: May the Dragon / Drake of ...(element).... bear witness to my actions. I embrace the magic, I call to it, to further me in my goals, actions and dreams this day.
description: This stackable glyph will grant the caster a boon form his Dragon or Drake. This takes the form in game terms equivalent to the innate powers granted to the elves / draves of the respective dragon / drake. Obviously only Elves and Draves with an established Mana Dragon or Drake may be pacted. Thus this may not be used to gain Drowe, Winter, Wood, Faerie nor Seasonal Elf innates. The first rune grants 4 levels of elven innates, each additional rune will grant +1 level of innates. Thus 5 runes will grant 8th level magical innates. Whilst active the caster may not recover the mana spent on this spell, without it ending the Pact early. A Sorcerer may learn this spell once for each set of innates, though they must possess a Ward Pact with the relevant Dragon/Drake to do so. This spell can only grant one set of innates each day. It is not possible to cast it, use the innates, remove it, and recast it for a new set of innates. The duration of the spell is based on the number of runes cast: 1 Rune – One Hour 2 Runes – Three Hours 3 Runes – Six Hours 4 Runes – Twelve Hours 5 Runes – Twenty Four Hours It is not possible to cast this spell with greater than 5 runes. This spell stacks with normal Elven innates but is not multiplied by x2/3 innates-type abilities.

name: Heart of Ice
verbal: Winter's here, the air is chill. You fall upon a snow-topped hill. You try to rise, to crawl once more, then slump again, you've lost this war. The gods it seems have rolled their dice. Your blood is cold, your heart is ice! Heart of Ice!
description: One flesh-and-blood creature has their heart turned briefly to ice, causing terrible system shock. Effects as per a Location-to-Zero the chest. In other words, chest location is reduced to zero life-points (unless it was already below that, in which case the spell has no effect). Immunity to Flesh and Blood Effects applies and Resistance to Sever or Immunity to Cold mean that location is reduced only to half its current life points. No form of armour class may be applied. Witch Doctor Magic These spells may only be acquired by a Witchdoctor.

name: Touch of Light
verbal: Into my hand I call forth the purest light, the raw mana of the White Dragon. Let its touch purge the darkness.
description: Upon completion of the verbal the caster has 10 seconds to touch their target. The spell causes the target to suffer X Blasts as per a Sabre of Light and Truth. X is equal to the skill level of the caster.

name: Arm Elemental
verbal: Elemental that I have called, be thou armed against my foes!
description: This spell transforms an elemental slightly such that its hands become either a one-handed sword or mace, increasing damage inflicted by 6 points, to a maximum of 24 points. This spell transforms both of the elemental's hands simultaneously and physical reps must be used.

name: Banish
verbal: Creature from elsewhere I command thee return to thy home, Banish... 4 Levels/10 hits.
description: This spell will drive away to its home plane, (not to return unless summoned again), a supernatural evil/good creature from another plane. Note that this does not include elementals or undead. This is a stackable glyph, similar to the Sleep spell detailed in the Standard Spells section. The spell caster may use more than one rune to increase the spell’s capacity to banish more powerful creatures. If learnt with points this spell comes with 5 runes.

name: Bind Elemental Servant
verbal: (A) of (B) I bind thee now into this artefact, to serve your master well.
description: Summons an elemental and binds it to a weapon or a shield, making it +0 magic of the same colour as the elemental bound (not however 'fire-based' if a salamander, for example - just red mana). The elemental so bound is considered to be a level '6' elemental and is negated / negates another elemental exactly as an elemental '6' would. If negated then the spell is ended.

name: Blade Rune - Death
verbal: By my arts and sorcery I inscribe the rune of death upon this blade - let any struck topple and fall before its humbling power.
description: This spell is a stackable glyph that may be cast on any bladed weapon, with the caster inscribing a magical rune on the weapon (if even with his finger) as the spell is cast. The next blow struck with that weapon by the caster inflicts a cumulative 3 TBLP magical touch effect (1 hit to monsters) per stackable rune - So two runes would inflict a 6pt touch effect. MAC applies on a 1:1 ratio. Additionally it causes unconsciousness (as per Catalepsy) for 1 minute per 6 TBLP inflicted after the target's defences. Resistances to Catalepsy apply as normal. Resistance to Death Rune applies. If learnt with points this spell comes with 5 runes. This spell cancels any other Blade Rune spell active on the target weapon when cast.

name: Blade Rune - Enervation
verbal: By my arts and sorcery I inscribe this rune of Enervation upon this blade - let any struck feel their life essence suffer and diminish.
description: This spell may be cast on any bladed weapon, with the caster inscribing a magical rune on the weapon (if even with his finger) as the spell is cast. The next blow struck with that weapon by the caster inflicts a magical (grey mana) Level Drain on the target. Multiple Enervation runes may be drawn on the weapon, triggering with each successive blow, although a dagger-sized weapon can hold only a single rune, a broadsword-sized weapon at most 2 runes, a bastard sword-sized weapon 3 runes and a great sword-sized weapon 5 runes. This spell may be learnt for 50pts for 5 runes. This spell cancels any other Blade Rune spell active on the target weapon when cast.

name: Control Animation
verbal: By my mastery of the elements and the might of sorcery I bid thee obey me now, sword.
description: This spell will allow the caster to take control of another's Dancing Sword/Dancing Venom Sword. It will not function on Intelligent Dancing Swords.

name: Embody Elemental
verbal: ...(B)... of ...(A)... share my form and grant me thy power!
description: The wizard may embody an elemental 6 that they already have under control. This spell is otherwise as per the Embody Elemental spell listed in the General Magic section, bar the reduced mana cost.

name: Ward the Supernatural
verbal: With my arts and powers and these runes I inscribe let those not of this world be barred from passage.
description: Acts in a similar manner to Protection from Spirits, except it functions vs Demonkind, Angels, and similar otherworldly beings. It functions vs creatures below the caster’s skill level, and only vs those susceptible to magic. It does not affect Undead or Elementals. The Ward may be a 15ft Line, or a 6ft Radius circle.

name: Blade Rune - Vorpal Wounding
verbal: By my arts and sorcery I inscribe this rune of Vorpal Wounding upon this blade - let any struck feel their body rip and tear.
description: This spell may be cast on any bladed weapon, with the caster inscribing a magical rune on the weapon (if even with his finger) as the spell is cast. When wielded by the caster, a weapon bearing a Vorpal Wounding rune inflicts wounds which cannot be fully healed. This means 1 point of damage per damage grade may not be healed until the target has a good night’s sleep. This spell cancels any other Blade Rune spell active on the target weapon when cast.

name: Blade Rune: The Fatal Blow
verbal: As I inscribe this run let it strike deep and sharp, let mortal armour offer no defence to this power.
description: Castable on a Bastard Sword, Bastard Axe, or large sword/axe. It causes the next blow delivered to be a sever. If the blow is parried then the rune is wasted. Resistance to Sever applies as normal, and damage is based on the current life of the location, not its maximum.

name: Evoke Greater Guardian
verbal: I entreat the powers of magic, let an enchanted guardian appear, come forth greater guardian, your aid is demanded to defend me from assault!
description: As per Evoke Guardian, above, but the creature has 40htk and possesses +2 grades of strength.

name: Evoke Greater Portal Guardian
verbal: Mighty Portal Guardian I evoke thee, come hither now, heed my commands and guard this way lest I be angered and cast thee down!
description: As per Evoke Portal Guardian, above, bar the creature has 50htk and possesses +2 grades of strength.

name: Evoke Guardian
verbal: I entreat the powers of magic. Let an enchanted guardian appear to defend me from assault!
description: This summons a humanoid Demonkind, which will stay with the Sorcerer and remain passive until either the Sorcerer himself or the guardian is attacked. At this point it will attack the assailant until either the assailant or the guardian are killed. If the guardian is still alive he will return to a neutral stance until the activation sequence is triggered again. The guardian requires 25 hits to kill and delivers damage by weapon type with +1 Strength. The guardian is summoned with a one-handed weapon, but may use any class of weapon bar machine propelled or hand thrown. The guardian may not use a shield.

name: Evoke Portal Guardian
verbal: Mighty Portal Guardian I evoke thee, come hither now and guard this way lest I be angered and cast thee down!
description: This summons a humanoid Demonkind to guard an indicated doorway. The SECFAP cannot attack anyone until it is attacked, or if an individual tries to pass the portal. If activated it will attack no further than 4 paces from its portal, and is only vulnerable to attacks originating from within 4 paces of its portal. If not activated it will stand in the portal, blocking access. The nature of the portal guardian means that it is not possible to bypass it unobserved by the use of Invisibility or similar. It is totally aware of the presence of all animate things with in its defence area, similar to Wanderer's Hunch. It is not possible to Blink or otherwise magically shift through the doorway the guardian protects, but it is possible to do so through the wall at least 4 paces away from the portal. Where paces are used they are measured as the paces of the portal guardian. The portal guardian requires 30 hits to slay it and delivers damage by weapon type +1 strength. When summoned it arrives armed with a +0 magical Bastard sword only usable by the portal guardian which is destroyed when the guardian dies.

name: Intelligent Dancing Sword
verbal: Lords of air I implore thee, lend me thy aid and let this sword dance to my will!
description: Exactly as per the Blue magic glyph in the Advanced Grimoire.

name: Summon Elemental 'Champion'
verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of ...(A)..., I entreat the elements of Fire, Air, Earth, Water, Light and Darkness. Come forth Champion of ...(A)... let a ...(B)... of ...(A)... appear to do my will.
description: This spell conjures an elemental ‘Champion' to be commanded. An elemental 'Champion' may take 40 hits before being destroyed, inflicts 15pts of damage with its hands and has 10th Level Resistances. It will not be negated by being struck by a 4 or 6 mana elemental, only by an 8 mana or higher elemental. All other details are as the standard Summon Elemental spell, such as Sylph '6' on page 16.
